You have to learn to make your ''own decisions''.|Rex|{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}}} '''Rex''', designated '''CT-7567''', was a veteran [[Clone Captain]], [[Clone Commander]], and [[Advanced Recon Commando]] who [[Commanding officer|commanded]] the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]'s famed [[501st Legion]] of [[clone trooper]]s during the [[Clone Wars]]. Rex later served as a [[captain]] and [[commander]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Rex participated in many battles over the course of the Clone Wars. As the captain of the 501st, Rex served as third-in-command to [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], whose bravery and unconventionality in battle he came to share. In addition to being a close friend of Skywalker, he also became friends with Skywalker's [[Padawan|apprentice]], [[Ahsoka Tano]]. He was close with [[Clone Marshal Commander|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody]], with their relationship mirroring that of their respective Jedi [[General]]s, Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], whom Rex was also well acquainted with. Rex and his companions often worked together during the front-line campaigns against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Throughout his career, Rex proved to be an effective leader who truly cared for the men under his command, even as he began to doubt his own future—and those of his clone brethren—in the Republic. His leadership was put to the ultimate test at the [[Battle of Umbara]], when he was forced to lead the 501st [[Legion]] under the obstinate and aggressive Jedi General [[Pong Krell]], who was secretly a Separatist agent. Rex's experiences with Krell forced him to reappraise his rigid adherence to orders—however, this had not been the first time Rex had questioned his purpose and orders. A notable example had been during the [[Battle of Saleucami]], when he allowed the clone deserter [[Cut Lawquane]] to stay out of the war. Rex used his combat skills and training to help train [[Onderon rebels|local insurgents]] on [[Onderon]] to [[Onderonian Civil War|emancipate]] their world. Rex's faith in the Republic was sorely tested by events such as the framing of Tano as well as the [[death]] of his longtime friend and comrade [[Fives]], who had gone rogue after unearthing an anti-Jedi directive known as [[Order 66|Clone Protocol 66]] that had been [[Behavioral modification biochip|bred]] into all the Republic's clone troopers. Fives's death led him to uncover his inhibitor chip, which enabled him and his longtime friend Ahsoka to escape Order 66 after the [[Siege of Mandalore]]. After living on [[Seelos]] with fellow Clone Commanders [[Gregor]] and [[Wolffe]], Rex joined the [[Phoenix Cell]] and reunited with his old friend Tano. Rex also became a reliable ally of the [[Spectres]] rebel cell and forged enduring friendships with the [[Great Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his apprentice [[Ezra Bridger]] as well as the rest of the Ghost crew. During the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early stages of the Rebellion]], Rex would use his skills and knowledge to help advance the Rebel Alliance's cause. He was eventually promoted to the rank of commander and fought in the climactic [[Battle of Endor]], which saw the first death of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], the redemption of his former Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, and the destruction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|Come on, Rex, admit it. You've thought about what your life could look like if you were to also leave the army. Choose the life you want.''"
"''What if I am choosing the life I want? What if I'm staying in the army because it's meaningful to me?''"
"''And, how is it meaningful?''"
"''Because I'm part of the most pivotal moment in the history of the Republic. If we fail, then our children, and their children, could be forced to live under an evil I can't well imagine.|Cut Lawquane and Captain Rex talking in the second year of the Clone Wars|{{TCW|The Deserter}}}} The [[clone trooper]] originally known by the number CT-7567,{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} only to be later{{Databank|clone-captain-rex-biography-gallery|Clone Captain Rex Biography Gallery}} {{C|Image 1 caption}} and better known by his adopted name of Rex, was, like the rest of his [[Cloning|clone]] brothers, created from the genetic template of the [[Mandalorian]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}} [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] in the clone [[Factory|factories]] of the [[planet]] [[Kamino]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] He was amongst the first generation of clones created for the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Grown to be among the greatest [[soldier]]s in [[the galaxy]] and a leader,''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' Rex was given additional command training and was promoted to be a [[Clone Captain]] in the Grand Army of the Republic.''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Like other [[clone trooper officer]]s, Rex was given [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC]] training.{{HelmetCollectionCite|76|Helmets}} After his training was complete, Rex was assigned command of the [[501st Legion|501st Clone Battalion's]] [[Torrent Company]]. Rex's instructors also bestowed his helmet with [[Jaig Eyes]], a Mandalorian{{InsiderCite|227|Rex & Roll}} combat honor.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' ===The Clone Wars=== ====Early battles==== {{Quote|You… came for me.''"
"''It should have been ''me'' who went in the first place.|Captain Rex and Anakin Skywalker|{{StoryCite|story=501 Plus One|book=Age of Republic Special 1}}}} Rex served in the Grand [[Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] to protect its citizens{{TCW|Trespass}} as part of his loyalty to the Republic. He participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' massive force of [[battle droid]]s.{{Rebels|The Last Battle}} Rex and his [[clone trooper]]s fought well and earned veteran status in the Republic Army. Throughout the war, Rex's reputation continued to grow, eventually resulting in the captain becoming considered the hero of the clone army.{{SW|url=battle-scars-episode-gallery|text="Battle Scars" Episode Gallery}} {{C|slide 5}} Despite only being a captain, Rex was assigned leadership of the 501st itself. In the aftermath of the Battle of Geonosis, the 501st Clone Battalion was reorganized{{HelmetCollectionCite|16|Helmets}} and sponsored by Republic Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], eventually turning it into the 501st Legion,{{EncyclopediaCite|Imperial Troops}} and placed under the command of the recently-[[Jedi Knight|knighted]] Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker]],''[[Darth Vader: Sith Lord]]'' with Rex being assigned as Skywalker's first-in-command. [[File:RexIsUnconscious-501PlusOne.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Anakin Skywalker tells Rex that he should have been in the fray.]] Rex participated in the [[Battle of Arantara]], where he led his soldiers to the frontline without Skywalker. Injured and knocked out, with Rex's armor also damaged in the conflict, Rex's life was in danger until he was saved by Skywalker.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Awaking later, Rex expressed surprise that Skywalker had come back for him, to which Skywalker responded that it should have been him in his place and that a leader always leads from the front. Rex soon developed a respect for his general, with Skywalker also quickly coming to respect the captain.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' The two even became friends. Rex was eager to follow orders early in the war but became less tightly wound in time. Rex also worked alongside Commander [[Cody]] at incidents such as [[Tibrin]].{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} He also came to meet and befriend [[clone commando]] [[Gregor]].{{TBB|War-Mantle}} At one point during his service, Rex and his fellow clones encountered [[dekamite]]s, which they dubbed "swamp spiders," but defeated them.{{RebelsAnimationCite|1|A Trooper's Worth}} At another point, Rex[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{Subtitles|Disney+}} and other clones were confronting a large force of enemies. The clone captain ordered [[Squad 2 (Galactic Republic)|Squad 2]] to pick their targets and, after another clone exclaimed that there were too many opponents, warned [[Gold Six (clone trooper)|Gold Six]] to watch their [[stabilizer]]. Rex also ordered another individual to watch out for what was happening at their left. Rex, Skywalker, and several of his men undertook a mission to [[Benglor]]. There, they ran into a [[Unidentified Benglor creature|creature]] that ate several droids and clone trooper [[Bellow]]. Rex ordered a retreat, but clone trooper [[Hardcase]] disobeyed orders and turned his [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] on the creature. Skywalker later saved Hardcase. ====Siege of Hisseen==== Rex, along with his 501st, Cody's [[7th Sky Corps]], and Commander [[Wolffe]]'s [[104th Battalion]] were [[Siege of Hisseen|sent]] to [[Hisseen]]. There, they protected the [[Hisseenian]]s from the Separatist Droid Army. After Generals Skywalker, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Plo Koon]] finished the last of the droids, Rex and the rest of the Republic forces continued to protect the Hisseenians.[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 1|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 1]] Rex and his troops continued to handle the droids while Cody and Wolffe's troops rescued the [[Hisseen's parliament|Hisseenian parliament]].[[Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales 2|''Star Wars Adventures: The Clone Wars – Battle Tales'' 2]] ====Battle of Christophsis==== {{Quote|So if you're a captain, and I'm a Jedi, then technically I outrank you, right?''"
"''In my book, experience outranks everything.|Ahsoka Tano and Rex|}} Sometime after the siege of Hisseen, Rex accompanied Skywalker, Kenobi, Cody, and the rest of the Republic forces in their effort to liberate [[Christophsis]] from Confederate forces under General [[Whorm Loathsom]] and [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s [[assassin]], [[Asajj Ventress]]. The captain took part in setting up an ambush on the approaching Separatist forces, but Kenobi and Cody were ambushed themselves. Skywalker rushed to his master's aid with Rex and his men alongside him. Fleeing to the rooftop, they held off the battle [[droid]]s until evac arrived in the form of a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i gunship]], with clone [[trooper]] [[Gus]] removing the commanding [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|tactical droid's]] head before departing. Rex assisted Cody in performing a [[robolobotomy]] on the droid's head, discovering that it contained all of their intelligence. Surmising that this meant there was a [[spy]] in their midst, Skywalker and Kenobi departed to investigate the [[Christophsis Separatist headquarters|Confederate headquarters]], hoping this would reveal the spy's identity. Rex and Cody were instructed to conduct their own search at the Republic base.{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} [[File:Christophsis_investigation.png|thumb|right|275px|Rex and Cody conducting their investigation]] As they were leaving the command center, Cody noticed that someone had left their [[comlink]] on; their entire conversation had just been broadcast to the Separatist spy. Rex spotted someone in the corridor, and he and Cody gave chase. However, they lost him in the busy mess hall. They now realized the spy was a clone. Unable to reach the Jedi as a result of blocked communications, Rex had [[R2-D2]] analyze the communication history to see if anyone had sent any unauthorized transmissions. He noticed irregular wavelengths that were too low and infrequent to be detected normally, wavelengths that were coming from [[Clone Sergeant|Sergeant]] [[Slick]]'s barracks. They proceeded to question Slick's men, all of whom had an alibi except [[Chopper (clone trooper)|Chopper]], who lied about collecting battle droid fingers. However, Slick slipped when he revealed that he knew the Jedi were gone, drawing the suspicion of the entire group. Slick realized he was blown and fled, evading Rex and Cody while also blowing up the nearby weapons depot as well as many of the LAAT/i gunships and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE]] walkers. Following a lead from Gus and Chopper, Rex and Cody ventured back to the command center. There, they noticed boot prints that trailed up towards the vents. Without a word between the two of them, Rex and Cody devised a trap; Rex pretended to leave the room, while Cody stood with his back to Slick's hiding spot as well as his blaster. Slick slid out of the vents and pointed the weapon at the back of Cody's head, but is shocked to learn that the blaster was empty, as Cody took the clip out beforehand. After a short fistfight, Rex and Cody subdued Slick, just as the Jedi returned from their fruitless trip to the Separatist headquarters. Skywalker verbally rebuked Slick for placing his brothers at risk, and Slick replied with an attack on the Jedi's enslavement of his brothers, the clones. Despite Slick scorching the entire weapons depot, Rex and Cody noted that they were able to save the [[AV-7 Anti-vehicle Artillery Cannon|heavy cannons]]. [[File:Rex_and_Ahsoka.png|thumb|left|275px|Rex met Ahsoka Tano on Christophsis.]] As Loathsom's droid army moved in on their positions, Rex and his men accompanied Skywalker as he took on the [[Octuptarra tri-droid|tri-droids]]. Soon after, Rex met Skywalker's new [[Padawan]] apprentice, [[Ahsoka Tano]], laughing as she called Skywalker "Skyguy." For laughing, he was told to show her the ropes as a commanding officer, offering her advice and valuable leadership experience. He also stated that while she may outrank him, experience outranks everything. Rex soon spotted the [[deflector shield]] being used by the incoming Confederate forces, rendering their [[cannon]]s useless. After conferring with Kenobi, Cody, and Rex, Skywalker and Tano left to destroy the deflector shield, while Rex assisted Kenobi in holding back the droids before they could destroy the heavy cannons. As Kenobi led a charge against the droids, Rex and his men drew the droids into the buildings, making the fight more manageable for the clones. Despite this, most of Rex's unit was wiped out, and he was soon ordered to pull back his forces in order to protect the cannons. As Kenobi delayed Loathsom with a drawn-out surrender, Rex noticed the shield drop just in time and ordered the cannons to finish off the tanks, ending the battle. The battle had only been the beginning of the long partnership between Rex and what would prove to be a tightly knit group of Jedi consisting of Kenobi, Tano, and Skywalker. Through this partnership, Rex would learn his opinions were valued. ====Battle of Teth==== {{Quote|Surrender, Republic dogs!''"
"''We've got you outnumbered!''"
"''''Outnumbered?'' Wait. One, two, three—|A B1 battle droid and Captain Rex|audio=Outnumbered-TCWf.flac|}} Rex, alongside Skywalker, Tano, and the rest of [[Torrent Company]], went to [[Teth]] to [[Battle of Teth|rescue]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt's]] son, [[Rotta]]. They used their ascension cables to climb the cliffs to the [[B'omarr Order Monastery|monastery]] under fire from two droid battalions. Rex and his men secured the monastery. After Skywalker and Tano found Jabba's son, Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] attacked as two [[C-9979 landing craft|Separatist landing craft]] deployed more battle droids under the command of Ventress. Rex and his men retreated into the monastery. [[File:RexOutnumbered-TCWf.png|thumb|right|250px|Rex and another trooper surrounded by battle droids]] Rex and his men stayed behind to keep the battle droids busy. After Ventress cut the door's lock, Rex and his men fought the droids, but the droids subdued his men. Rex picked up his pistol and tried to shoot Ventress, who disarmed and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force-choke]]d him, demanding the location of Skywalker. Rex refused, but Ventress tried to use a [[mind trick]] to make him contact Skywalker. However, Rex managed to resist the mental attack{{EncyclopediaCite|The Grand Army of the Republic}} and, upon contacting his general, chose to break protocol by calling Skywalker by his first name, resulting in Skywalker realizing that Ventress was coming. After the clone captain and his surviving troops were taken to the courtyard, Skywalker contacted Rex, so a battle droid came over to investigate. Rex punched the unit and took its weapon. Rex and his troops then fought the droids guarding them. As they were surrounded, help arrived from Kenobi and Cody. After destroying a spider droid with a detonator, Rex told Skywalker they could take care of themselves and that the mission came first. Rex then went with Kenobi, Yoda, and Cody to pick up Skywalker and his apprentice from [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine]]. ====Battle of Mimban==== {{Quote|501st advance! Mud jumpers, back up General Laan Tik.|Rex, during the Battle of Mimban|}} [[File:B1sAttackRex-501PlusOne.png|thumb|left|260px|Rex was willing to fight alone to protect his troops during the Battle of Mimban.]] Rex later fought in the [[Battle of Mimban]] along with the [[Mud Jumpers]] of the [[224th Imperial Armored Division|224th Division]] and his troopers in the 501st. Jedi General [[Laan Tik]] led Republic forces in the battle until he was killed. Afterward, [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] became the highest-ranking member despite having no combat experience, and the chain of command fell to him. After the Republic fell back to their camp, Rex spoke with several of his troopers about the location of the droids' shield generator. Knowing that it was a suicide mission, Rex decided to call in an exfil shuttle to pull his men out. Rex decided to undertake the mission by himself but was followed by one of his troopers and Representative Binks. Rex then attacked and fought the battle droids for several hours until he was shot and pushed to the ground. He was saved by Representative Binks, who used Tik's lightsaber. Despite saving his life, Rex took Tik's lightsaber and gave a blaster to Binks. The two of them continued to fight the droids. ====Skirmish on the Rishi Moon==== {{Quote|Permission to take point, sir?''"
"''I'm always first, kid.|Hevy and Rex|}} [[File:Rex_inspirational.png|thumb|right|280px|Rex told his fellow clones that their current battle was not only for the Republic, but also their fellow clones on Kamino.]] Rex went with Cody on an inspection tour on the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class transport]] ''[[Obex]]''. After inspecting the tracking station at Pastil, Rex and Cody went to the [[Rishi Moon]] [[Rishi Station|station]]. En route, Rex contacted the station. Rex noticed something odd about the trooper's reluctance to their inspection. After landing, Rex and Cody were greeted by another trooper who said that the base was fine and asked them to leave. Rex demanded to be taken to the sergeant in command after the disguised droid said "roger roger." When the survivors of the station launched a droid attack flare, Rex realized that the clone trooper in front of them was actually a droid and promptly shot it in the head, much to Cody's surprise. Rex told him to relax and removed the clone trooper's helmet, revealing it to be [[Unit 26]] , a [[BX-series droid commando]]. They then came under attack by more commando droids that cut them off from the ''Obex''. Rex and Cody jumped off the platform as the commando droids threw detonators at them. They used their ascension cables to climb down. They met the surviving troopers, [[Fives]], [[Hevy]], and [[Echo]], who at first they ordered to remove their helmets to prove they weren't droids. After removing their helmets, they came under attack by a [[Rishi eel]], but Rex shot it in the eye. Rex marked Echo with the eel's blood and realized that they were "shinies," clones that had not fought before. He wanted to show them a taste of battle and brought them back up to the platform. As they did not have the equipment to bypass the blast doors, Rex devised a plan to act as a malfunctioning droid commando; Cody believed that the plan was absurd, but Rex persuaded the droids inside to open the door. Rex, Cody, and the rest of the clones then stormed the command center, taking out the commando droids. They spotted a Confederate fleet approaching, but were unable to contact the Republic. [[File:EchoFivesHonored-Rookies.png|thumb|left|280px|Fives and Echo being assigned to the 501st Legion by Captain Rex.]] When a landing craft came down, Rex said they would blow up the station so that the Republic fleet would arrive to investigate. Rex rigged the gas detonators as Cody and others held up the battle droids. However, the remote detonator was not working. Rex and the others left while Hevy fixed the detonator. However, Hevy refused to leave, intending to set the gas off manually. Rex and the others tried to go back for him, but Hevy blew up the station along with himself. Rex and the others were rescued by a gunship. After Echo and Fives received [[Unidentified medal (Defense of Rishi Station)|medals]] for their bravery, Rex accepted them into the 501st Legion. ====Battle at Bothawui and Skytop Station==== {{Quote|Rex, ol' boy, it's time to join the party."
"With pleasure, sir!|Rex beginning the ambush onto the Separatist ships|{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}}} [[File:ReportFromFalleen-DOAD.jpg|thumb|right|266x266px|Rex, Tano, and Skywalker receiving the report about Falleen from Kenobi]] After the [[Battle of Falleen|loss]] of the [[Falleen battle group]], Rex, Skywalker, Tano, and their fleet were sent to protect [[Bothawui]]. Rex and the fleet's AT-TEs were deployed on the asteroids surrounding Bothawui. As General [[Grievous]]'s fleet moved in to [[Battle of Bothawui|attack]] Skywalker's fleet, Rex and the AT-TE opened fire on the rear of the enemy fleet. Rex saved Skywalker when his fighter was damaged, then stayed with Ahsoka as Skywalker searched for Grievous's [[Skytop Station|spy station]]. When Rex and Ahsoka detected Skywalker's tracking signal, they took the ''Twilight'' and rescued Skywalker from Grievous's forces. Rex assisted Skywalker in his search for the listening post. After receiving a message from R2, Rex, [[Denal]], and his squad accompanied Skywalker in destroying the station in the [[Ruusan]] system. Rex also carried [[R3-S6]] down to the station. Rex, Ahsoka, R3, and the rest of the squad were sent to destroy the station's reactors while Skywalker searched for R2. However, R3 slowed them down, leading to a confrontation between super battle droids. They subdued the droids, but Rex, Ahsoka, and the squad were then confronted by General Grievous. Rex and his squad tried to shoot, but all were killed except Rex and Denal. As Rex was about to be killed, he was saved by Ahsoka, who ordered Rex and Denal to complete their mission without her. Rex and Denal rigged the reactors and rendezvoused with Skywalker and the ''Twilight'' in the landing bay. However, Rex and Skywalker realized that R3 was a spy when he summoned super battle droids and vulture droids to attack them. Rex destroyed the reactors, and they were joined by Ahsoka and made their escape, with Skywalker rescuing R2.{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}} ====Battle above Quell and crashing on Maridun==== {{Quote|Captain Rex, keep your locator on. We should be back by day break with whoever, or whatever lives on this planet.''"
"''Got it, General Secura. Hey kid, good luck.|Secura and Rex, with Rex saying the final part to Ahsoka|{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}}} [[File:LibertyRescue-JC.png|thumb|left|243x243px|Rescuing Secura and Bly]] Later during the conflict, Rex joined Skywalker, Tano, [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]], and several other clone troopers on a mission to the planet [[Quell]], where Jedi General [[Aayla Secura]] and her [[Clone Commander|clone commander]], [[Bly]], were fighting a Separatist opposition. With Secura's cruiser damaged, the Republic forces were in a hurry. After breaking through a line of rocket super battle droids, they landed on Secura's ship, where Skywalker was injured in an explosion on the exploding ship. With fellow troopers [[Cameron]], [[Flash]], and [[Lucky]], Rex, Tano, Secura, Bly, and Skywalker escaped on a transport vessel. However, they were hit and entered [[hyperspace]]. Their ship then crash-landed on the planet [[Maridun]]. Rex stayed behind to look after Skywalker while Secura, Bly, Ahsoka, and the other troopers went to look for help. Rex fought the [[mastiff phalone]]s alongside Skywalker until Bly, Ahsoka, and the [[Lurmen]] healer [[Wag Too]] came to his aid. Rex and his fellow clones and Jedi quickly discovered that Maridun was home to a Lurmen village. ====Defense of Maridun==== [[File:Clones_maridun.jpg|thumb|right|251x251px|Rex and Bly firing blasters on Maridun]] Rex watched for any spacecraft, hoping for rescue. Rex soon spotted a Confederate landing ship coming toward the village. He informed Bly of this, and they escaped from the village before the battle droids arrived. Rex and the others planned to steal a shuttle but were spotted by a [[Ringneck recon droid|recon droid]]. They pursued it until Secura destroyed it. Rex and the others then watched as General [[Lok Durd]] prepared to test his weapon. Rex went with Bly to get a closer look at the weapon. Rex and Bly then ran to avoid the weapon's shock wave using their grapnel lines.{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}} After Durd left, Rex worked with Bly and Skywalker to infiltrate Durd's base, where they stole a shuttle and [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]]. Rex and the group returned to the village, where Skywalker, Bly, and he built a wall to withstand, much to [[Tee Watt Kaa]]'s disapproval. Rex and Bly activated the shield as the [[Defoliator Deployment Tank|Defoliator]] fired its weapon. Rex and the others [[Defense of Maridun|stood their ground]] until the droids breached the shields and destroyed it. Luckily, Rex, Bly, and the others then had help from the Lurmen, and subdued and captured Durd. As Rex was taking Durd, Republic cruisers arrived to rescue them. ====Battle of Orto Plutonia==== [[File:Clones_Orto_Plutonia.png|thumb|left|236x236px|Rex and his troops on Orto Plutonia]] Rex accompanied Generals Kenobi and Skywalker, [[Pantoran]] [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]], and Chairman [[Chi Cho]] to [[Orto Plutonia]]. There, they investigated [[Glid Station]] to ascertain what happened to the troopers. Rex and the Jedi went to a Confederate outpost, where they saw a hologram of a creature [[Skirmish on Orto Plutonia|attack]] the battle droids. Rex returned to the station, where he and his troops waited for the Jedi's return. Rex and his troops then went with the Jedi, Chairman Cho, and Senator Chuchi to speak with the Talz Chief, [[Thi-Sen]], at the Confederate base. After the meeting, Rex was charged with protecting the Chairman when he decided to [[One-Day War|attack]] the Talz. Rex, his troopers, Cho, and his [[Pantoran guard|guards]] were surrounded by the Talz. When Cho was mortally wounded, Rex and his men retreated, carrying the Chairman with him. Alongside Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and Binks, they destroyed all the droids and stopped them from unleashing it on Naboo. Skywalker and Kenobi administered a cure to them and saved them. ====Battle of Ryloth==== [[File:Rex_Resolute.png|thumb|left|243x243px|Rex watching Ahsoka's plan]] Rex, along with Skywalker, Tano, and Yularen, took the ''Resolute'' and their fleet to Ryloth to break the Confederate blockade. After Skywalker destroyed the Confederate command ship, Rex, Yularen, and the navigation officer maneuvered the ''Resolute'' into the attack position. They watched as Tano and her bombers destroyed the remaining forces. Rex sent a ship to pick up Skywalker's and R2's pod as Kenobi's and Windu's forces landed.{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}} ===The conflict draws on=== ====First Battle of Felucia==== {{Quote|Come on, grunts! Skywalker ordered her and her clones to evacuate, and as all Republic forces lifted off, the regrouped droid army decimated Tano's abandoned vehicles. ====Battle of Devaron==== [[File:ForceCollection-Captain-Rex.png|thumb|left|220px|Rex fights atop Cad Bane's frigate above Devaron.]] Rex went with Skywalker and Tano to Devaron to stop the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] from taking the [[Kyber memory crystal]] from Master [[Bolla Ropal]]. Rex told Skywalker the blood was not from one of his men. Rex and Skywalker then realized that Denal was actually Bane in disguise, but he escaped.{{TCW|Children of the Force}} ====Battle of Malastare==== Rex accompanied Skywalker, Windu, and Commander Ponds to oversee the Republic's defense of the beleaguered planet, as the Grand Army coveted its vital [[Malastarian fuel|fuel]] reserves. The Supreme Chancellor Palpatine responded by authorizing the use of the [[electro-proton bomb]], a creation of Doctor [[Sionver Boll]] that would generate an [[electron]] field capable of deactivating the entire droid army. Rex was tasked with shoring up the fortifications of the [[Doge's Palace]]—the residence of [[Doge]] [[Nakha Urus]], the leader of the [[Dug]]s—until the bomb was detonated, and he proceeded to the front of the palace's defense lines to command the Republic troops, monitoring the massive droid army's approach with a set of [[electrobinoculars]]. Rex held the line with his men, working in tandem with squads of [[insectomorph]]-mounted [[Dug cavalier]]s to repel the droid infantry.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}} A starfighter squadron dropped the electro-proton bomb in the middle of the droid army, producing an explosion that transformed into an [[electromagnetic pulse]]. The bomb also destabilized the surrounding ground, and Rex nearly fell into the expanding sinkhole when he became trapped on an unstable plateau, but managed to jump to higher ground with the help of his troops. After Windu and Urus conferred with Palpatine on the status of the Republic's [[Treaty of Malastare|fuel treaty]] with the [[Dug Council|Dugs' council]], Rex reported that they had lost contact with the rescue team in the crater. As night fell, Rex met with Skywalker, Windu, and Boll at Urus's palace to discuss the problem of the uncontrollable [[Zillo Beast]] with Palpatine. While the Dugs wanted to kill off the Zillo Beast, the Jedi wanted to preserve the creature, as it was one of the last of its near-extinct species. Skywalker devised a plan to knock out the creature with the Republic's [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tanks]] and then transport it off-world. The Republic forces rendered the Zillo Beast unconscious with Skywalker's strategy, Rex returned with Skywalker and Windu to the Doge's Palace, where Urus and the other Dug leaders signed the fuel treaty. Later, Palpatine ordered they bring it to Coruscant for study before its release into the wild. Rex returned to Coruscant with Skywalker, Windu, and Boll aboard an [[Unidentified Acclamator-class assault ship (Zillo Beast)|''Acclamator''-class transport]]. The Zillo Beast [[Zillo Beast incident|broke out]] of the Science and Technical Center and began to rampage across the [[ecumenopolis]] of Coruscant. As the creature headed for the [[Imperial Executive Building|Republic Executive Building]], Rex joined an LAAT/i gunship force led by Kenobi and Windu that had set out to contain the beast. He contacted Skywalker through R2-D2, both of whom were with Palpatine and Padmé Amidala in the [[Emperor's office|Chancellor's Suite]] at the Executive Building, and confirmed that he was to serve with Kenobi for the time being. Yet when Rex, Kenobi, and Windu reached the [[Imperial Plaza|Senate Plaza]] with their detachment of clone troopers and [[stun]] tanks, they found that the Zillo Beast had taken hold of the [[Palpatine's H-2 executive shuttle|H-2 executive shuttle]] that Palpatine, Skywalker, and Amidala had been using to flee from the Executive Building with R2-D2 and C-3PO.{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}} Rex, monitoring the Zillo Beast and its captives through a pair of [[macrobinoculars]], noticed that Skywalker was cutting the [[H-2 executive shuttle|shuttle]] in half with his lightsaber and notified Windu. Kenobi deduced that Skywalker intended to free himself and the other passengers by severing the ship in two. While the recently arrived Yoda and Aayla Secura ran interference to distract the Zillo Beast, Skywalker finished slicing the shuttle in half, freeing himself and the others from the creature's grip. Kenobi and Windu quickly used the Force to stabilize the section of the shuttle carrying Palpatine and a [[Unidentified Senate Commando (Zillo Beast incident)|Senate Commando]], preventing them from falling off the dome of the Executive Building. While the stun tanks targeted the Zillo Beast, the LAAT/i gunships launched with Rex, Kenobi, Windu, and their men aboard and also opened fire, though neither approach proved effective in subduing the rampant beast. Palpatine ordered the gunships to release toxic [[gas bomb]]s that Boll had developed to kill the creature. The next morning, the slain Zillo Beast was transported back to the Science and Technical Center. Rex and his comrades met with Palpatine in the Senate Plaza to debrief the disaster, mourning the loss of the creature. While Rex and the others departed from the Senate Plaza aboard the gunships, Palpatine secretly gave Boll orders to clone the Zillo Beast. ====Second Battle of Geonosis==== [[File:RexBlastersGeonosis.png|thumb|right|235x235px|Rex on Geonosis]] Rex fought with Skywalker, Tano, and his troops when the Republic [[Second Battle of Geonosis|returned]] to [[Geonosis]]. Rex then contacted Tano and informed Skywalker of this.{{TCW|Brain Invaders}} ====Battle of Saleucami==== {{Quote|Rex is a smart man.''"

Always thinking on his feet.|Commander Cody and Obi-Wan Kenobi on Saleucami|}} [[File:RexLawquaneAndFamily.jpg|thumb|left|234x234px|Rex parted with Cut as equals.]] Rex accompanied Skywalker and Master [[Adi Gallia|Gallia]] to the [[Saleucami system]] to [[Battle of Saleucami|rescue]] Master [[Eeth Koth]] from General Grievous. With this, he left to rejoin Kenobi and his other clone brothers. ====Skirmish on the ''Coronet''==== Following Kenobi's investigation on [[Mandalore]],{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}} Rex, Cody, Skywalker, and several troopers were requested to [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet|protect]] the [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]] and her entourage from the [[Death Watch]] and the Separatists aboard the ''[[Coronet]]''.{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}} [[File:JediCoronetBriefing.png|thumb|right|253x253px|Rex with the other Republic forces aboard the ''Coronet'' receiving orders from Kenobi]] Rex, Cody, and their troops were briefed on the importance of protecting the Duchess. General Fisto is expecting us.|Captain Rex, to Anakin Skywalker|{{TCW|The Academy}}}} When the [[Jedi High Council]] chose Ahsoka Tano to teach students at the [[Imperial Academy of Mandalore|Royal Academy of Government]] to help break the cycle of corruption on the planet, Rex accompanied Skywalker and Tano to the planet. [[File:Anakin_Captain_Rex_Padme_and_Ahsoka.png|thumb|left|235x235px|Anakin Skywalker, Captain Rex, Padmé Amidala, and Ahsoka Tano]] In an attempt to force [[Pantora]] to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems, members of the Trade Federation loyal to the Separatists, such as [[administrator]] [[Sib Canay]], arranged the [[blockade of Pantora]]. Following the battle, Rex promoted Echo and Fives to be Advanced Recon Commandos. {{Expandsect}} ====Extraction on Lola Sayu==== {{Quote|I am concerned that the Jedi have elected this... child to lead the group.''"
"''I've served with her many times and I trust her, Captain.|Captain Tarkin and Captain Rex discuss Ahsoka Tano|{{TCW|Counterattack}}}} [[File:KoonBriefing-Citadel.png|thumb|left|250px|Rex and others attending the briefing about the Citadel.]] One [[Standard year|year]] and nine [[Standard month|months]] after the First Battle of Geonosis,{{TCWcanondates|318}} when Jedi Master [[Even Piell]] was [[Capture of Even Piell|captured]], Rex, appearing via hologram, Cody, Fives, Echo, Kenobi, and Skywalker attended a briefing held by Plo Koon for a [[Battle of Lola Sayu|mission]] to rescue Piell from the [[Citadel]] on [[Lola Sayu]], where he was imprisoned by the Separatists. In order to get on the planet undetected, Skywalker had the entire rescue team, including Rex, [[Carbon-freezing|carbon-frozen]]; before being frozen, Rex confided in Skywalker that he had never gone through the process before, only for Skywalker to admit it was his first time as well.{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}} Despite Rex and Fives's reservations, the team was successfully frozen, surviving the process and being brought aboard [[Shuttle 81572]]. The frozen team was smuggled by R2-D2 and three reprogrammed battle droids in a stolen Separatist shuttle. This tactic fooled the life-form scanners of the blockade around the planet, and its crew and the droids landed the shuttle in a cave close to the Citadel prison. After landing, Rex and the others were unfrozen, only to discover that Tano had secretly joined the team, despite having been ordered not to. Since there was no other option, Tano came along, and the team began the mission. [[File:TarkinRex-TC.png|thumb|right|200px|Rex with Tarkin during the escape]] To get into the facility, the team had to free-climb a wall covered with [[Electro-mine|electromines]]. This went well until clone trooper [[Charger]] stepped on a loose rock and fell straight into a mine, alerting the prison crew of the team's presence. On the way to Piell's cell, the team had to evade several booby traps, one killing another clone trooper, [[Longshot]]. The team made it to Piell's cell and destroyed the droids that were guarding Piell, with Rex taking care of the interrogator droid. On the way to rescue Piell the group was located by the Citadel's warden, [[Osi Sobeck]], who activated a large magnet in the ceiling of the hall that pulled all the team's weapons away, as well as Skywalker, due to his [[Cybernetics|cybernetic arm]]. The team was surrounded by droids. Skywalker, being attached to the magnet, reclaimed his [[lightsaber]] and destroyed the magnet, allowing the team to reclaim their weapons and destroy the droids. Rex shot a surveillance camera, much to Sobeck's frustration, before moving along. After retrieving Piell's officers the group split into two groups while escaping the facility, as both Piell and his captain, [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Tarkin]], knew half of the vital hyperspace coordinates, called [[Nexus Route]]. Splitting them up during the escape would make it more difficult for the Separatists to get the full information. Rex joined the group consisting of Skywalker, Tano, Tarkin, Echo, Fives, and two rescued clones. While Kenobi and the other group wreaked havoc on the upper levels, Rex and his group escaped the tower into a series of tunnels on the lower levels. Rex and the others made their way through tunnels fighting off the super battle droids and commando droids. He also defended Ahsoka when Tarkin questioned her experience. They met up with Kenobi's and Piell's team at the airfield. However, their shuttle was destroyed, and ARC trooper Echo was believed to have been killed.{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} Rex and the others headed for a rendezvous point as they were pursued by [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform|STAPs]] and [[anooba]]s. Upon reaching the rendezvous point, they fought Commandant Sobeck and his droids until Koon arrived. Rex and the others were then taken back to Coruscant.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} ====Return to Felucia==== Rex went with Skywalker, Tano, Koon, Wolffe, and their men to take out a resupplied [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)|Separatist outpost]]. How about we call you Bats.''"
"''Sound good to me.|Rex and B1-0516|{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=19|story=Roger Roger}}}} [[File:RexOnHorainSWAdventures19.png|thumb|right|250px|Rex pinned down by battle droids, wearing Phase II trooper armor]] By the time of the [[Battle of Horain]], Rex was equipped with [[Phase II clone trooper armor]]. When Rex and Kenobi returned to the [[Republic Evacuation Point]], Bats joined the Republic. ====Battle of Umbara==== {{Quote|You are making a mistake by crossing me, clone.''"
"''It's 'captain,' sir.|General Krell and Captain Rex clash after the captain disobeys direct orders|}} [[File:RexSkywalker-Umbara.jpg|thumb|left|255x255px|Rex and Skywalker on Umbara]] Rex, along with Skywalker, Fives, and the rest of the 501st were [[Battle of Umbara|sent]] to [[Umbara]] to help Masters Tiin, Krell, and Kenobi take its [[Umbaran capital city|capital]], while Tano and Offee fought the space battle. When Krell ordered a full-frontal assaults on the capital, he denied Rex's request to carry out Skywalker's plan. As they made their way through the gorge, they were attacked by the Umbarans' [[Impeding Assault Tank|crawler tanks]], which they destroyed. Despite Krell's orders to push the attack, Rex and his men held them off until Fives and Hardcase destroyed the MHCs. The base was taken and secured despite the heavy losses.{{TCW|The General (episode)}} [[File:RexvsKrell-Umbara.png|thumb|right|250x250px|Rex and many of his men did not agree with Krell.]] When Kenobi contacted them about the capital's long-range missiles being supplied by a [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel]], Rex proposed that they attack the ship to cut off the supplies. Rex at first complied but was then told of an idea by Fives to use the starfighter codes to infiltrate and destroy the supply ship. However, Krell objected to it. Following a mishap in a hangar, Rex gave Fives, Jesse, and Hardcase permission to carry out the mission. However, he told them that if they were caught, he would not be able to protect them. Despite Rex's objections, Krell had Fives and Jesse taken to the brig for insubordination.{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}} [[File:MarchToKrell-CoK.jpg|thumb|left|220x220px|Rex leading the 212th and the 501st to arrest General Krell]] Rex spoke with Krell to convince him to spare Fives and Jesse, telling him that the men were with him despite his reckless tactics. Rex and Krell were then contacted by a trooper who informed them that they were ambushed by the Umbarans disguised as clones. Rex was sent to attack the Umbarans. Rex and his men, armed with [[mortar]]s, went into the jungle, where they were attacked by the troopers. However, Rex examined one of the troopers and discovered they were clones. Rex ran in front of both his men and the troopers, revealing the deception. Rex then spoke with the [[212th Attack Battalion]] platoon leader, [[Waxer]], who revealed that it was Krell who ordered the attack before dying of his wounds. [[File:Rexecutioner-CoK.png|thumb|right|245x245px|Krell's execution]] Rex gathered his men and the remainder of Waxer's platoon and told them that they would arrest Krell for [[treason]]. Rex and the men confronted Krell, who was surprised that he had figured it out. Krell, believing Rex and his men to be committing mutiny, refused to be arrested and ignited his lightsabers. After a short fight, Krell leapt from the tower and quickly incapacitated the force of clones that was waiting outside, fleeing into the jungle. Rex and his men pursued the Besalisk. Rex was alerted by a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Umbara)|trooper]] that had located him, but Krell tore through several clones with ease, taunting Rex all the while. However, after many casualties, Krell was tricked by Tup into walking towards a vixus, giving them an opportunity to stun Krell. Rex and his men placed Krell in the brig. During his questioning, Rex learned that Krell was trying to undermine the Republic so that Dooku or his master would make him his new apprentice and rule Umbara. When news came that Kenobi and 212th had taken the capital, Rex and the others decided to execute Krell. At first, Rex hesitated but Krell was then killed by Dogma. Dogma was then taken into custody, but he and Rex shared a nod.
