Rex departed then, telling Hunter to say goodbye to the boys for him and contact him when they figured themselves out. As Rex began walking away, Hunter told him that if he was ever in trouble, that they would be there for him, and Rex gratefully nodded before departing. Although Hunter felt that the Bad Batch was on a different path compared to Rex, Echo believed the squad should have left with his old friend, knowing it would mean they would not need to work for Scaleback and that it would let them be soldiers.{{TBB|Reunion}} ====Rescue of Gregor==== {{Quote|I received a distress signal from a clone trooper, but I'm a bit tied up at the moment to retrieve him.''"
"''You want us to recover a reg?''"
"''He's an old friend, and he's in trouble. I need you to get him out.|Rex and Hunter|}} [[File:RexHologramMarauder.png|thumb|left|250px|Busy with a mission of his own, Rex asked the Bad Batch to rescue Gregor.]] Sometime later, while Rex was on a mission of his own, he received a distress signal from his old friend Gregor; the clone commando had tried to desert from the Empire while training the first generation of the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] on the world of [[Daro]], yet he had been captured after planting the distress signal. Unable to go after Gregor himself, Rex instead contacted the Bad Batch as they traveled through hyperspace on a mission for Scaleback. After asking the commandos to [[Extraction on Daro|liberate his friend]] but realizing he needed to cut his transmission short, Rex sent them Gregor's signal and ended his call. In the ensuing debate amongst the Bad Batch, Echo remained steadfast in his devotion to help his former captain, understanding that Rex would only contact them if it was important. Although it meant they may not get paid by Scaleback for their current mission, the squad ultimately decided to travel to Daro, where Echo, Tech, and Hunter departed from the ''Marauder''. After analyzing the Imperial base they needed to break into, Hunter realized that the odds were against them, making him consider leaving and telling Rex that the mission was not possible. However, Echo implored Hunter and Tech to continue the mission, remembering their mission to Skako Minor to rescue him. Convinced, the three broke into the facility and rescued Gregor, who trusted them upon learning Rex had sent them, but Hunter was ultimately left behind and captured by the Empire. Leaving{{TBB|Return to Kamino}} the injured Gregor on Ord Mantell with Scaleback, the Bad Batch traveled to Kamino to [[Rescue of Hunter|rescue Hunter]], ultimately learning he was being held by Crosshair in the [[Tipoca City Training Facility]]. Ordering Omega to stay behind with droid [[AZI-345211896246498721347]], Echo instructed her to return to the ''Marauder'' and contact Rex if they sent her a warning signal. Upon receiving the signal, she instead decided to activate training droids, which freed the Bad Batch and allowed them to capture Crosshair. Meanwhile, Ahsoka had moved to the world of [[Thabeska]] before moving to the small farming moon [[Raada]] around a year later. On Raada, she sometimes thought about Rex. ====Returning to Coruscant==== When Rex was contacted by the clone trooper [[Slip (clone trooper)|Slip]], who sought to escape Imperial service and get offworld, he returned to Coruscant to help his brother. However, when he arrived at their agreed-upon rendezvous, he heard blasterfire and ran to investigate, finding Senator Riyo Chuchi being pursued by an [[Clone X|assailant]]. Rex stunned the attacker and helped up Senator Chuchi, who recognized him from their time together during the Clone Wars. When Rex removed the attacker's helmet, he saw the face of a clone. Together, they decided to question the individual, with Rex bringing them to a [[Martez sisters' repair shop|repair shop]] that belonged to his associates, namely [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez]]. Rex questioned the trooper, but he used a [[Electro capsule|suicide shocker]] to kill himself rather than reveal any information. Senator Chuchi explained to him that Slip had been caught up in a conspiracy regarding the [[Attack on Kamino|destruction]] of Tipoca City and the subsequent cover-up by Vice Admiral Rampart. She also described the context of the incident, namely that the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]] that would see the decommissioning of all clones without pensions or any form of compensation. In response, Rex contacted the Bad Batch to help them acquire evidence to use in the Imperial Senate to charge Rampart. Having learned from Slip that such proof could be located in the bridge Rampart's Star Destroyer, Chuchi told Rex of this and when the Bad Batch arrived, Rex led them on an infiltration mission while Omega joined Chuchi in the Senate building.{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}} [[File:RexInfiltrateRampartShip.png|thumb|right|250px|Rex and the Bad Batch infiltrates Rampart's ship to extract crucial information.]] Rex led the Bad Batch into the [[Coruscant shipyard|Imperial shipyard]] where Rampart's ship was docked by accessing a maintenance tunnel that found them near the ship. During their journey, Rex told Echo about how more and more of their brothers were waking up to the Empire's treatment of them and needed help, something he was trying to provide them. After sneaking onboard the ship, Tech rerouted power to the bridge so they could access the data, although this triggered a security alarm. Rex and the other clones fought off the clone stormtroopers advancing on them and eventually escaped the ship by crashing it and using an escape pod to the maintenance tunnel. They then piloted a landspeeder to Omega and one of Chuchi's guards, who relayed the data to Senator Bail Organa, who presented it in the Senate. Rampart was subsequently arrested, although the Defense Recruitment Bill would pass following a statement by Emperor Palpatine. Back at the repair shop, Rex lamented that Palpatine was always steps ahead of them making the outcome of the situation unchanged. Senator Chuchi declared that she will continue to fight for clones as their representative in the senate before the Bad Batch departed without Echo who declared his intentions to join Rex in his quest to aid their clone brothers across the galaxy. ===Agent of the Rebellion=== ====Joining the Rebellion==== {{Quote|Believe it or not, the time comes when even the staunchest of soldiers needs to step away from the fight.|Rex|''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''}} Eventually, Rex met with Commander [[Wolffe]], the former commander of [[104th Battalion|Wolfpack]], and Gregor, and the trio began living in a [[Rex's AT-TE|modified AT-TE]] on the desert planet of [[Seelos]]. Several years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]], Tano tried to contact Rex, but her transmissions had gone unanswered since Wolffe had hidden their existence from Rex, fearing that the Empire would come for them if they were found colluding with a former Jedi. When Rex was unresponsive, Tano sent a group of rebels that included the [[Great Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his [[Padawan|apprentice]] [[Ezra Bridger]] to find Rex and obtain information from him on abandoned bases that the growing rebellion could use in their struggle against the Empire. [[File:Wolffe-4-retina_92972cde.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rex and Wolffe greet the rebels from Lothal.]] Rex and his comrades' first encounter with the ''[[Ghost]]'' rebels almost ended in violence when Kanan thought the clone troopers were a threat and ignited his lightsaber. Rex's timely intervention broke up the fight between his comrades and Kanan. When Kanan's apprentice Ezra mentioned that he and his rebel companions had been sent by Ahsoka, Rex quickly realized that the rebels were friends and introduced himself and his companions. While meeting with the rebels inside the walker, Ezra tried to convince Rex and his companions to join the fight against the Empire. Rex laughed and declined, saying that his days as a soldier were over. After discussions with Kanan, Rex agreed to create a list of bases that the rebels could use but invited the four rebels to participate in a hunt for [[joopa]]s as payment for supplying them with this information. He later breaks in on Kanan and Ezra's discussion about Order 66 and stated he didn't betray his Jedi. To allay Kanan's distrust of clone troopers, Rex revealed that he, Gregor, and Wolffe had managed to remove their control chips, allowing them to disobey that order and he remarked they all have a choice. The rebels reluctantly participated in the joopa hunt with the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]] acting as both the "hunter" and the "bait." Zeb was swallowed by the joopa but succeeded in killing the creature. Having completed their side of the deal, Kanan wanted his rebel companions to leave but Rex invited them to stay for dinner. While dining, the Mandalorian teenager [[Sabine Wren]] discovered that Wolffe had secretly alerted the Empire to their presence and hid the messages that Ahsoka had sent them. Wolffe, who distrusted the Jedi, had informed the Empire in the mistaken belief that he was protecting himself and his fellow clones. Rex was shocked by this revelation and confronted Wolffe. He convinced Wolffe that the rebels were their friends and that the Empire was their enemy. Shortly thereafter, the clones and rebels were visited by an Imperial [[probe droid]] which damaged their auxiliary ship, the ''[[Phantom]]''; preventing them from rendezvousing with their fellow crew aboard the ''Ghost'', which was waiting in space. After destroying the probe droid, Rex and his companions prepared for the arrival of the Empire. [[File:Ahsoka_embraces_Rex.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano and Rex embrace after years of being apart.|left]] Despite Ezra's efforts to encourage Rex and his companions to join the Rebellion, Rex was adamant that the clones would stay behind to hold back the Empire while the rebels escaped on the ''Phantom''. A force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT walkers]] led by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Alexsandr Kallus]], a perennial foe of the ''Ghost'' crew, [[Assault on Seelos|landed on Seelos]]. Despite being outnumbered and outgunned, Rex and his fellow clones stood their ground. At the urging of Ezra, the rebels intervened in the fight and defeated the Imperials. Without air support, Kallus and his surviving [[AT-AT pilot]]s were forced to retreat into the desert. Honored that Kanan and Ezra would return to save them, Rex and his comrades saluted the Jedi and agreed to join the Rebellion. Meanwhile, Gregor and Wolffe stayed behind and turned the remaining AT-AT into their new home.{{RebelsRecon|Jdj4teY5gik|#2.06: Inside "Wings of the Master" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-wings-of-the-master}} Hera then arrived with the ''Ghost'' to pick them up. Later, the rebels returned to meet Ahsoka and revealed that Rex had joined them. Rex proudly strode forward, and Tano smiled as she walked up to him. Rex playfully joked that she had gotten old, and after Tano smiled that it had to happen sometime, she embraced her old friend. Rex returned the hug warmly. ====Wits versus discipline==== After joining the Rebellion, Rex became part of the Phoenix rebel cell, which operated a fleet in space.{{Rebels|Always Two There Are}} At some point after joining the rebels, Rex piloted a [[Rebels TIE fighter|TIE fighter]]{{FFGXW2|set=Rebel Alliance Conversion Kit|cardname=Captain Rex}} that had been captured by the Spectres sometime prior. The fighter had been repainted by Wren{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}} and was used by Rex in combat, firing its cannons. During one of Ezra's levitation lessons, Rex exposed Sabine and [[C1-10P|Chopper's]] trick that involved locking the astromech droid Chopper's feet to the floor, preventing Ezra from levitating him. When Ezra was upset about the trick, Rex told the young Padawan about how a Jedi General he had once fought alongside became a great warrior by combining the Force with his wits. In response, Kanan told Rex that the boy had a lot of wits but needed more discipline. While Rex and Kanan argued about how to train Ezra, the young Padawan sneaked away with Sabine, Chopper, and Zeb on a [[Skirmish aboard a Republic medical station|mission]] to salvage supplies from an Old Republic medical base. Rex had provided the rebels with the codes to this station. Unknown to the rebels, two [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] known as the [[Seventh Sister]] and the [[Fifth Brother]] were waiting for them. The rebels barely escaped with their lives. Rex was present with Kanan and Hera when the younger rebels returned with news that the Empire had more Inquisitors. Later, Rex oversaw target practice with Ezra, who was using a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] to try and hit a stormtrooper helmet that Chopper was moving around. Kanan came out, sternly reminding Ezra about his Jedi training, which sparked a minor debate between Rex and Kanan until Sabine informed them that Hera had called for a mandatory group meeting. The rebels then participated in a mission to scour [[Garel City]] for power generators and Fuel Cells to alleviate an energy crisis on the planet [[Rinn]]. ====Infiltrating the Imperial Interdictor==== An opportunity for Rex to resolve his differences with Kanan Jarrus arose after Ezra Bridger and [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]]'s [[CR90 corvette]] [[Liberator (CR90 corvette)|''Liberator'']] were captured by an [[Interdictor (Interdictor-class)|Imperial Interdictor]] during a mission to the [[Del Zennis system]]. Prior to their capture, Sato had warned the other rebels that the Empire had a new warship capable of pulling ships out of hyperspace. Under the orders of Phoenix Leader Hera, Rex along with Kanan and Chopper were to infiltrate the Imperial warship and rescue Bridger and Sato. For this mission, Rex and Kanan were to disguise themselves as stormtroopers while Chopper was painted black to mimic an [[Imperial communications droid]].{{Rebels|Stealth Strike}} When Kanan expressed unease about working with Rex, he reassured him that he knew which side he was on. After Zeb brought two captured sets of [[stormtrooper armor]], Rex complained that the new armor was junk compared to the [[Clone trooper armor|armor]] he had worn during the Clone Wars. For their mission, Rex, Kanan, and Chopper used a stolen [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] to travel to the Del Zennis system, which they learned had been classified by the Imperial authorities as a restricted testing area. While traveling through hyperspace, the two men argued about their mission. While Kanan wanted to find their people and get them out of Imperial custody, Rex insisted on disabling the new ship as well since it could pose a threat to the Rebellion. Upon approaching the Imperial Interdictor, Rex conned the Imperial scanners by telling them that his shuttle was having engine problems. Using emergency protocols he and Commander Cody had invented, they gained permission to dock in the Imperial Interdictor. After landing, Kanan used a Jedi mind trick to convince the stormtroopers guard in the hangar to let them through. Accessing a terminal, they learned through Chopper that Ezra was being transferred to a secure cell; meaning that the Empire had learned his identity. Disguised as stormtroopers, the three rebels made their way to Ezra's cell only to discover that the young Jedi had already broken free and locked his captors in his holding cell. [[File:Stealth_Strike_ep_guide.png|thumb|250px|Rex and Kanan reveal themselves to Ezra.]] Mistaking Rex and Kanan for stormtroopers, Ezra [[stun]]ned them with his [[Ezra Bridger's first lightsaber|lightsaber-blaster]]. When Rex and Kanan recovered, Ezra tried to save face by claiming that they had been involved in a big firefight. Chopper, however, played a holographic recording of what actually happened. While Kanan was furious, Rex laughed it off and suggested that Ezra should have set his blaster to kill in case it was not them. When Rex and Kanan broke into an argument about whether to limit their mission to rescuing their rebel comrades or destroying the ship as well, an irritated Ezra broke off and accompanied Chopper on a mission to sabotage the Imperial Interdictor's [[gravity well projector]]s. Disguised as stormtroopers, Rex and Kanan continued their mission to rescue their rebel comrades. When they stumbled on a stormtrooper patrol, Rex advised caution but Kanan decided to attack them. During the firefight, Rex complained that he could not see through his stormtrooper helmet and threw it at one of his opponents, knocking him out. After braving heavy fire, Rex and Kanan finally reached the detention cell holding Commander Sato and his crew. They decided to make their way back to Commander Sato's CR90 corvette ''Liberator''. On the way, they were attacked by more stormtroopers. Rex decided to buy his rebel comrades more time by holding off their pursuers and locking the blast doors. Rex took on the remaining stormtroopers in single-hand combat only to be stunned. Captured, Rex was brought before the Interdictor's commanding officer, Admiral [[Brom Titus]]. Recognizing Rex based on his code number, Titus tried to win Rex over by offering him immunity and reinstatement at an [[Imperial Academy]] if he would convince his compatriots to surrender. However, Rex rejected Titus' terms and the Admiral ordered an [[IT-O interrogation droid|interrogator droid]] to torture him to death while two stormtroopers pinned him down over a round portal. Meanwhile, the other rebels reached Sato's corvette safely. After hearing Rex being tortured through the Force, Kanan decided to rescue Rex. Before Admiral Titus could finish Rex off, Kanan entered the command bridge disguised as a stormtrooper and opened fire on Titus' men. After freeing Rex, the two men escaped on an [[escape pod]] and boarded Commander Sato's corvette. They attempted to flee into hyperspace but were again pulled out by the Imperial Interdictor. However, Chopper had rigged the Interdictor's gravity well projectors to draw in everything nearby including two escort [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|light cruisers]]. These light cruisers crashed into the Interdictor; destroying it in a fiery explosion. Rex and the other rebels escaped into hyperspace in the nick of time. Following their escape, Commander Sato praised Rex, Kanan, and Ezra for rescuing him and his crew. Rex also thanked Kanan, who had finally overcome his animosity towards clone troopers. As a gesture of reconciliation, the two men saluted each other before they parted company. ====Escape from Garel==== Due to an accidental leak by Ezra Bridger on [[Takobo]], the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother learned that the Phoenix rebel cell was hiding on Garel. The two Inquisitors informed their Imperial colleagues [[Agent]] Kallus and Admiral [[Kassius Konstantine]], who sent an Imperial fleet from Lothal to attack Garel City. During the escape, Rex was with Commander Sato when their CR90 corvette was caught in the [[tractor beam]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless]]'', Konstantine's ship. However, [[Phoenix Leader]] Hera freed Rex and Sato by using the ''Ghost'' to ram into the Star Destroyer's [[tractor beam projector]]. This enabled the remaining Phoenix rebel ships to escape into hyperspace.{{Rebels|Legacy (episode)}} ====Trouble at Concord Dawn==== [[File:Concord_Dawn_planning.png|thumb|250px|Rex present at the planning of the mission to Concord Dawn|left]] Rex was present during a meeting with Commander Sato and the crew of the ''Ghost'' to discuss the establishment of a new hyperspace route to the [[Lothal sector]]. With the Empire hunting them down throughout the Outer Rim, the rebels were in need of a new hyperspace route that would allow them to bypass Imperial forces. During the meeting, Sabine suggested that the rebels try penetrating the [[Concord Dawn system]], which was home to a [[Mandalorian]] colony known as the Mandalorian Protectors. Rex advised his fellow rebels that the Mandalorians who inhabited the planet [[Concord Dawn]] had helped train clone troopers during the Clone Wars. At the end of the meeting, the rebels decided to send a diplomatic mission led by Hera, the leader of [[Phoenix Squadron]], to negotiate for safe passage with the Protectors.{{Rebels|The Protector of Concord Dawn}} Hera's diplomatic mission failed since the Protectors led by [[Fenn Rau]] had aligned themselves with the Empire. Under Rau's orders, the Protectors' [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|Gauntlet fighters]] engaged Hera's [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s in a vicious [[Dogfight over Concord Dawn|dogfight]] above Concord Dawn. Several rebel A-wings were destroyed, and Hera was badly injured. Following the dogfight, Rex was present during a briefing where Sabine, one of the survivors, reported on the dogfight with Fenn Rau. Rex recalled that Rau had served as an instructor in the Grand Army of the Republic. With Commander Sato's permission, Kanan along with Chopper and Sabine took part in a [[Mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|mission]] to destroy the Protectors' starfighters on the [[third moon of Concord Dawn]]. ====Mission to Geonosis==== [[File:Rex_firing_at_ATDP.png|thumb|250px|Rex using the ''Ghost''{{'s}} forward laser cannon to clear the station's hangar of AT-DPs]] Rex accompanied the crew of the ''Ghost'' to investigate an [[ICM-092792|Imperial construction module]] above the planet Geonosis. As a veteran of the Clone Wars and a participant of the second battle that took place on the planet, Rex was aware that Geonosis was home to billions of [[Geonosian]]s. Thus, he was surprised when Chopper picked up no sign of life on the planet. Ezra then sensed through the Force that all life on Geonosis had been [[Sterilization of Geonosis|extinguished]]. Upon landing in the seemingly abandoned module, Rex stayed aboard the ship with Hera and Chopper while the other rebels went to explore the station. Shortly, they discovered that they had stumbled into a trap set by the Imperial Security Bureau Agent Kallus.{{Rebels|The Honorable Ones}} While Rex helped Hera to man the ''Ghost''{{'s}} defenses against Imperial [[All Terrain Defense Pod]] walkers, Chopper freed the other rebels by unlocking the blast doors from the control console. Rex and the other rebels escaped the Imperial module aboard the ''Ghost''. However, Zeb was separated and escaped in an escape pod with Kallus. After escaping Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]], Rex and his fellow rebels began looking for Zeb. Despite sweeping through the system, they were unable to find Zeb, which led Rex to remark that the Lasat had a slim chance of survival. Meanwhile, Zeb and Kallus landed on [[Bahryn]], one of Geonosis's moons. After working together to fight off [[Bonzami]] predators, the two struck an unlikely friendship. Zeb activated his transponder, and the crew of the ''Ghost'' rescued him. Rex and the other rebels except Chopper greeted Zeb at the ship's gangplank after landing on Bahryn. ====Finding a new base==== Later, Rex and several other rebels including Commander Sato, the Spectres, and [[Ketsu Onyo]], Sabine's friend, attended a briefing aboard the rebels' captured [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|Imperial fighter carrier]] to discuss their plans to set up a new rebel base. By cross-referencing several Republic and [[Lothal]]ian star charts, the rebels had identified the planet [[Berzite]]'s [[Berzite's moon|moon]] as a prospective candidate. Since the rebels' fighter carrier was low on fuel, Ketsu recommended stealing [[fuel]] from the Imperial depot at [[Horizon Base]].{{Rebels|The Forgotten Droid}} As a result of the meeting, Commander Sato sanctioned a mission by the Spectres to steal fuel from Horizon Base. Rex stayed aboard the rebel flagship during the Imperial [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] on the Phoenix rebel fleet. After Chopper and the former Imperial [[inventory droid]] [[AP-5]] relayed information about an Imperial trap in the [[Yost system]], Rex accompanied the rest of the Phoenix rebel fleet to [[Atollon]]; a safe world with no Imperial presence. ====Defending Chopper Base==== [[File:Sabine_Wren_and_Rex_on_Atollon.png|thumb|275px|Sabine and Rex outside Chopper Base|left]] Following the discovery of Atollon, Rex was placed in charge of the establishment of [[Chopper Base]] on the planet. From the base's command center, Rex commanded operations to deliver shipments to the base and to establish [[sensor beacon]]s that would serve as warning beacons for intruders. While Rex found the planet hot, dry, and unpleasant, he conceded that there was nothing trying to kill them. Later, he and Wren ventured to the base's northern perimeter to investigate the disappearance of [[Lieutenant]] [[Dicer]], who had disappeared after planting her sensor marker.{{Rebels|The Mystery of Chopper Base}} Under Hera's orders, Rex and Wren traveled there on the shuttle ''Phantom''. Upon arriving, they found Dicer's helmet but saw no sign of the rebel. Soon, the two rebels were attacked by several large spidery creatures called [[krykna]]. Wren held off the creatures, but Rex was taken captive. The krykna carried him down to their underground lair where he was held in the mandibles of a sleeping krykna which hung suspended from the top of the cavern. Sabine and the Spectres freed him but were pursued back to the surface by the [[krykna]]. Rex and his companions made it back to the ''Ghost'', but the starship was held down by a large web woven by the krykna. As the rebels fought to break their way out of the web, Rex and Chopper aided in the defense of the ship by fighting off a krykna intruder trying to breach the rear hatch. While Rex kicked and pushed the creature out, Chopper closed the rear doors. After escaping the krykna, Rex suggested reporting to Commander Sato that the base was unsafe. However, Syndulla responded that they had poured much effort into finding the base and should not give up. At Jarrus's suggestion, the rebels erected a fence consisting of sensor markers around the base the following day. ====Losing Ahsoka==== While Rex remained on Atollon{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}} as the [[overseer]] of Chopper Base's operations,{{InsiderCite|187|Clone Tales}} he kept in contact with Ahsoka Tano as she traveled with Bridger, Jarrus, and Chopper to the planet [[Malachor]] to seek answers on how to defeat the Sith. Holding Tano in high regard, Rex offered to come to her aid within two rotations. Tano declined the offer and reiterated that this mission was Jedi business. When Tano joked that she outranked Rex, he replied that experience always outranked everything. Tano replied that she had more experience than him due to her experiences during the Clone Wars and Jedi Purge. Rex remained at Chopper Base for the duration of the Jedi [[Mission to Malachor|mission]] to Malachor. In Rex's absence, the Jedi and Tano came into conflict with the Inquisitors and forged a tenuous alliance with the former [[Sith apprentice]] Maul to obtain a [[Sith holocron]] which purportedly contained the knowledge needed to defeat the Sith. After destroying the Inquisitors, Maul turned on the Jedi and blinded Kanan with [[Maul's lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. Later, the Sith Lord Darth Vader arrived, and the Jedi and Chopper managed to flee but Ahsoka chose to stay behind. Following the mission, Rex and the other Spectres were present on the runway when the ''Phantom'' landed at Chopper Base. They watched in silence as Jarrus, now blind, and Bridger disembarked from the ship. When Rex saw that Tano was not with them, he bowed his head in sadness at the thought of having lost his good friend. ====Heist at Reklam Station==== [[File:Rebels_on_Reklam_Station.png|thumb|275px|Rex (far right) and his team at Reklam Station]] After Ezra and his team rescued the [[Weequay]] [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] from the [[Naraka prison|Imperial prison]] at [[Naraka]], Rex attended a briefing where Hondo shared information on the Imperial floating junkyard [[Reklam Station]] inside the planet [[Yarma]] to the Phoenix rebels and Spectres. After Hondo revealed that the Imperials were dismantling Old Republic [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing starfighters]] there, Rex told his fellow rebels that the Y-wings were reliable combat fighters. In the end, the rebel leaders agreed to dispatch a [[Mission to Reklam Station|recon mission]] to Reklam Station.''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' Rex accompanied Ezra's team and Hondo on the ''Phantom'' to Reklam Station. On the way, the rebels exited hyperspace at [[Sereeda Waypoint]] where they were intercepted by a [[Mining Guild]] patrol. After escaping the Mining Guild patrol, the rebel team continued their journey to Yarma. While traveling inside Yarma's gassy atmosphere, the ''Phantom'' was pursued by two Imperial [[DTS-series dismantler droid|DTS-series Dismantler Droids]]. While Chopper shot down one, Rex opened the ''Phantom''{{'s}} rear hatch and fought with the second dismantler droid. He almost fell out but was pulled back into the ship by Zeb. In the end, Rex managed to shoot the droid but the ''Phantom'' sustained damage. Fortunately for Rex and his team, Sabine regained control of the ship. After parking the ''Phantom'' beneath the station, Rex and his team convinced the local Ugnaught laborers to help them steal the Y-wings in return for their freedom. After stopping the conveyor belt, Rex and the other rebels began refueling the starfighters. Rex commented that refueling the fighters would not be their first nor last complication. After the Imperial Commander Brom Titus activated the magnetic locks on the Y-wings, Rex and Ezra departed to attack the Imperial control tower. Rex was forced to return when a third dismantler droid attacked Chopper, Sabine, and Zeb. Rex used a magnetic crane to trap the dismantler droid against a metal container before pushing it down into Yarma's volatile depths. The dismantler droid erupted in flames. After Ezra cut off the station's power, Rex and the other rebels departed on the Y-wings. Chopper used the relay navigation system to remotely pilot the other craft. Rex then traveled in the same Y-wing as Chopper, and the rebels escaped into the space above Yarma. The rebel Y-wings were intercepted by an Imperial Star Destroyer commanded by [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]]. However, they were saved when the Phoenix fleet arrived with the fighter-carrier ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'' and evacuated the fleet. Due to the efforts of Rex and his team, the Phoenix rebels obtained five Y-wings which were then transferred to [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]'s [[Massassi Group|unit]]. ====Making peace with the past==== =====The last battle===== {{Quote|No... the war. It's not over!"
"Rex!"
"Cody!"
"Talk to me!"
"Ah, Kanan, I'm sorry, I thought you were someone else.|Rex, to Kanan, after waking up from being stunned|}} Facing a shortage of supplies, Rex, Kanan, Ezra, Chopper, and Zeb traveled to [[Agamar]] to obtain [[proton bomb]]s from a wrecked Separatist supply ship that had crashed on the planet during the Clone Wars. After landing on Agamar, Rex took the opportunity to tell the other rebels about his Clone Wars experiences. When Ezra opined that the B1 battle droids did not look dangerous, Rex responded that these droids had killed many of his friends. Rex and the other rebels soon found the munitions depot and discovered that it was full of proton bombs. Before they could proceed further, they were trapped in a [[ray shield]] and stunned by several battle droids led by [[B1-268]]. [[File:RebelRex_USWNE.png|thumb|left|200px|Rex forced to fight one last Clone Wars battle.]] After awakening, Rex and his fellow rebels found themselves prisoners of the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[Kalani]]. Kalani informed the rebels that he presumed the master control shutdown command issued to the [[Separatist Droid Army]] at the end of the war to be a Republic trick, and prevented it from disabling his battalion. Despite Rex insisting that the Clone Wars had ended and demanded that he and his friends be released. Kalani refused, stating that he would have one last battle; a victory for the Separatist Alliance. Zeb was the only one excluded from the battle on account that his species had not been involved in the Clone Wars. Though Rex, Kanan, and Zeb expressed their opposition to the war game, Ezra struck a bargain with Kalani. If the rebels made it back to the command center, Zeb would be free, and they would take all of the proton bombs in the hangar. Kalani accepted these terms, and the "simulation" began. Unknown to the rebels or the Separatists, Chopper had evaded the battle droids and sent a distress call through a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|Neimoidian escort shuttle]]. However, the Empire picked up the distress signal, and Governor Pryce gave the order for the nearest Imperial fleet to deploy forces on Agamar to wipe out the rebels. Back outside the supply ship, Rex, Kanan, and Ezra began the "simulation" as a large force of battle droids marched on their position. Utilizing a "sword and shield" maneuver whereby Rex would fire and the Jedi would deflect incoming shots, as well as using two thermal detonators to wipe out large sections of the droid attack wave, the trio made short work of the first group of battle droids. They reached the [[hangar]] bay only to find that Kalani had deployed three [[droideka]]s to intercept them. Unable to breach the droidekas' deflector shields, Rex and the rebels were forced to retreat. Rex and Kanan agreed to provide covering fire while Ezra headed into the hangar to collapse a catwalk over the droidekas. Ezra was delayed by an unexpected reunion with Chopper but still managed to collapse the catwalk with the Force. Meanwhile, Rex was hit in the chest by a blaster bolt from a battle droid but survived due to his clone trooper armor. While continuing their mission to the command bridge, they encountered Ezra. Rex chastised Ezra for his tardiness and warned him that one soldier's move affected everyone else in the team. In Rex's view, they needed discipline and strategy to succeed. Kanan counseled Ezra not to take the clone trooper's words personally because Rex was determined to finish the battle. After Rex knocked out another droideka with his helmet, the rebels managed to enter Kalani's command center and declared victory. However, Kalani disagreed on technical grounds and prepared to execute Rex. Before any further violence could break out, Ezra interceded and convinced the two sides to put aside their differences. After Imperial forces landed on Agamar and attacked B1-268 and a battle droid patrol, Ezra won over Kalani to their side by pointing out that the Empire was the successor to the tyranny of the Old Republic. Kalani accepted Ezra's logic and agreed to help the rebels formulate an escape plan. =====An unofficial end===== {{Quote|No, it was a victory. We all just won the Clone War, and you ended it Ezra. A galaxy of senators couldn't do that. An army of Jedi, clones, and droids couldn't find the middle ground, but you did.|Rex|}} [[File:Ezra_reasoning_with_Rex_and_Kalani.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ezra convinced Rex and Kalani to make peace.]] Working together, Kalani, Rex, and the rebels improvised a strategy that involved rolling the proton torpedoes onto the feet of the advancing Imperial AT-AT and AT-DP walkers. When Kalani admitted never attempting such a desperate strategy, Rex responded that was why the clone troopers won; prompting Kalani to reply "not always." After knocking out one of the AT-AT walkers, the rebels and droids fled aboard three Neimoidian escort shuttles while under fire from the Imperial walkers. One of the shuttles was shot down but the rebels' and Kalani's shuttles escaped into space. Once in space, Rex and the rebels corresponded with Kalani by hologram. When Kalani opined that their joint effort was a successful strategy but not a victory, Rex opined that it was a victory and thanked Ezra for finding a middle ground that allowed the clones and droids to end the Clone Wars. Both Rex and Kalani also accepted Ezra's explanation that both sides could not win the Clone Wars. Despite departing on friendly terms, Kalani thought that the rebellion had a poor chance of success and parted for parts unknown. Rex and the other rebels were later contacted by Hera. Despite not obtaining the proton bombs, they acquired a [[Phantom II|new transport]] for the ''Ghost''. ====Evacuation of Mykapo==== Rex and the Phoenix Squadron took part in a [[Skirmish over Mykapo|mission]] to evacuate rebel sympathizers from the planet [[Mykapo]] prior to an Imperial crackdown. After the ''Ghost'' and a local rebel cell called the [[Iron Squadron]] destroyed an Imperial advance patrol, Rex and the crew of a [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] evacuated the rebel sympathizers to safety. Rex contacted Hera and Kanan to inform them that he would be rendezvousing with the rebel fleet. Later, Rex corresponded with Hera and her crew by hologram while discussing a plan to rescue the Iron Squadron captain [[Mart Mattin]] from Imperial forces. This mission was ultimately successful, and Mart reunited with his uncle Commander Sato.{{Rebels|Iron Squadron (episode)}} ====The spectre of Maul==== Rex along with the Spectres and other members of Phoenix Squadron attended a briefing chaired by Hera Syndulla to discuss a planned strike against the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] on the planet Lothal. During the meeting, Ezra saw the former Sith apprentice Maul sneak past Rex. Using the [[dark side of the Force]] and [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[magick]], Maul haunted Ezra and caused him to faint. As a result, Hera proceeded on the Lothal mission without Ezra.{{Rebels|Visions and Voices}} ====Mission to Geonosis==== [[File:Spectres_and_Rex_on_Geonosis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rex and members of the Spectres on Geonosis]] Rex accompanied the crew of the ''Ghost'' on a [[Mission to investigate Geonosis|mission]] to find [[Saw Gerrera]] and investigate the apparent disappearance of the Geonosian species on Geonosis at the request of Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]; a key ally of the rebellion. Rex explained to the Spectres that he and Saw had fought as allies during the [[Clone Wars]]. He also warned his fellow rebels to be worried about what Saw did not find on Geonosis. The rebels landed near the Geonosian structure that Saw had last entered before losing contact with [[Alliance High Command|Rebel Command]].{{Rebels|Ghosts of Geonosis}} While exploring an underground labyrinth, Rex along with Kanan, Ezra, and Chopper found several discarded helmets belonging to Saw's team. Kanan and Chopper wanted to leave but Ezra and Rex were determined to find Saw and to complete their mission. After reaching a dead-end, the rebels were cornered by several battle droids and a droideka. Before the battle droids could finish off the rebels, Saw arrived and eliminated most of them with a grenade. After greeting his former comrade in arms, Rex and his fellow rebels agreed to help Saw find the lone Geonosian, who had ambushed and killed his group. Saw believed that the Geonosian held the key as to why the Empire had wiped out the entire population of Geonosis. Rex, the Spectres, and Saw eventually reached the central air shaft. After Kanan contacted Hera to warn about the operational battle droids, the rebels discovered the lone Geonosian on the other side of the shaft. While Ezra and Chopper pursued the Geonosian, Kanan used the Force to levitate Rex and Saw on a stone bridge over to the other side. Following a protracted pursuit, Rex and his comrades captured the Geonosian. While Saw was hostile to the Geonosian due to his animosity towards the Separatists, Ezra befriended the Geonosian, who was nicknamed "[[Klik-Klak]]." While making their way to an energy reading picked up by Chopper, Rex explained that Saw was still affected by the death of his sister [[Steela Gerrera|Steela]] at the hands of the Separatists. The rebels soon discovered that the source of the energy reading was [[Klik-Klak's nest]], which contained a working transmitter. While Rex and Chopper worked to establish contact with Hera, Saw and Ezra argued about Klik-Klak; who revealed that he was the custodian of the last Geonosian queen's egg. While Saw wanted to interrogate Klik-Klak offworld, Ezra insisted that Klik-Klak belonged on Geonosis since he was one of the few surviving members of his species. When Saw expressed his dislike for the Geonosians, Rex reminded him that his mission was to find out what had happened to the Geonosian species. In the end, Kanan brokered a compromise that involved bringing Klik-Klak to Chopper Base for interrogation and returning him to Geonosis once they had finished with him. After establishing contact with Hera, the rebels arranged to rendezvous with her at the central air shaft. After boarding the ''Ghost'', Rex and the Spectres became involved in an argument with Saw over the treatment of Klik-Klak. Saw broke his agreement with Kanan and demanded that the rebels let him leave with Klik-Klak and the Geonosian egg. During the argument, Saw electrocuted Klik-Klak with an electro-shock device, which prompted Ezra to lunge at him. Rex tried to restrain Saw but the other rebel knocked him to the ground. When Saw threatened to destroy the Geonosian queen egg, Rex reminded him that doing so would sully the memory of his sister. The rebels' argument was interrupted by the arrival of an [[Brunson's Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] commanded by Captain [[Brunson]]. Rex and his fellow rebels and Saw joined forces to repel a boarding party of [[Jumptrooper]]s. During the skirmish, Rex used the ''Ghost''{{'s}} [[laser cannon]] to blast several of the Jumptroopers. The ''Ghost'' then fled into the depths of Geonosis. There, the rebels and Saw discovered several Imperial poison canisters which the Empire had used to exterminate the Geonosians. Having found compelling evidence of the Imperial genocide, Saw experienced a change of heart and let Klik-Klak flee with the Geonosian queen egg into the depths of Geonosis. The rebels fought their way out of the air shaft by blasting Brunson's light cruiser with [[proton torpedo]]es. They informed Senator Organa and Commander Sato about their successful rescue of Saw, their acquisition of a [[deflector core]], and their discovery of the Imperial genocide against the Geonosians. ====Rescuing Kallus==== After the rebels learned that Grand Admiral Thrawn was monitoring the rogue ISB Agent Kallus's Fulcrum transmissions, Rex took part in a rebel mission to rescue Kallus before the Empire captured him. As part of the [[Rescue of Alexsandr Kallus|mission]], Ezra, Chopper, and AP-5 stole a shuttle from the planet Lothal's [[Capital City spaceport]] and allowed themselves to be captured by Kallus' Imperial light cruiser, which was captained by Lieutenant [[Yogar Lyste]]. Disguised as stormtroopers, Rex and Kanan traveled in the ''Sentinel''-class landing craft [[TY997]] to Lyste's light cruiser to facilitate the extraction.{{Rebels|Through Imperial Eyes}} The rebel mission was complicated when Grand Admiral Thrawn requested an audience with Kallus and Lieutenant Lyste aboard his Imperial Star Destroyer ''[[Chimaera]]''. After reaching the ''Chimaera'', Chopper informed Rex and Kanan about the change of plans. While Rex expressed shock, Kanan told Chopper to get them a fresh set of coordinates for the ''Chimaera'' since their current coordinates would only work on the Imperial light cruiser. Chopper complied and obtained the new set of coordinates with the help of Kallus and Ezra. After exiting hyperspace, Rex and Kanan discovered Thrawn's [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] orbiting Lothal. When Kanan asked which ship, Rex told him to transmit the coordinates at random. TY997 was cleared for landing aboard the ''Chimaera''. However, Thrawn had discovered that rebel infiltrators were aboard the shuttle and sent Governor Pryce to apprehend the intruders. Pryce saw through their stormtrooper disguises and ordered Rex and Kanan to surrender. When Kanan protested, Pryce stunned him. Rex shot one of Pryce's stormtroopers before fighting hand to hand with the governor. Pryce overpowered Rex and knocked him to the ground. However, Lieutenant Lyste, mistaking Pryce for Fulcrum, stunned her. Before Lyste could attend to Rex, Kallus tackled him to the ground. Rex and his fellow rebels then fled aboard their landing craft. Kallus opted to stay behind in order to continue helping the rebellion. He also framed Lyste as Fulcrum in an effort to draw attention away from himself, but Thrawn was not fooled. ===Alliance to Restore the Republic=== =====Mon Mothma's speech===== Rex along with Commander Sato and AP-5 were present at the Chopper Base command center when the former Imperial Senator [[Mon Mothma]] gave a live [[HoloNet]] speech denouncing the Empire and urging the galaxy to rise up in rebellion. =====Ezra's errant mission===== After Ezra Bridger heard [[Kanan Jarrus' holocron]] and the [[Sith holocron (Malachor)|Malachor Sith holocron]] warning that the [[Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi was in danger, Rex attended a meeting with Bridger, Commander Sato, and the other Spectres including Phoenix Leader Syndulla. During the meeting, Rex expressed sympathy for Bridger's desire to find Kenobi, but believed that Kenobi had perished, citing a report from Senator Bail Organa. Bridger disagreed and traveled with Chopper on a [[Mission to Tatooine (Imperial Era)|mission to find Kenobi]]. Bridger found that Kenobi was indeed alive and that Maul was no longer a problem, as Maul was finally killed by Kenobi shortly after meeting him.{{Rebels|Twin Suns (episode)}} =====Defending Chopper Base===== [[File:RexAndZebVsATATs-SWRS03E22.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rex and Zeb ambushing Thrawn's ground forces]] Rex took part in the [[Battle of Atollon]]. Before the Phoenix Squadron and General Jan Dodonna's Massassi Group could launch a coordinate attack on the Imperial TIE Defender factories on Lothal, Grand Admiral Thrawn learned the location of Chopper Base and invaded the [[Atollon system]]. In response, Hera devised a plan to sneak Ezra and Chopper out of the system aboard the Gauntlet fighter ''Nightbrother'' while launching a frontal attack on Thrawn's Seventh Fleet. Prior to the battle, Zeb and Rex joked about hunting joopas with Rex remarking they were hard to hunt but tasty.{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} During the space battle, Rex and Zeb manned the guns aboard the ''Ghost''. After Commander Sato sacrificed his life and command ship ''Phoenix Nest'' by ramming Admiral Konstantine's [[interdictor]] vessel, Ezra and Chopper escaped and sought reinforcements from [[Clan Wren]]. However, the rebel forces sustained heavy casualties at the hands of Thrawn's fleet and were forced to retreat to Atollon. Rex and Zeb managed to activate Sabine's prototype deflector shield generator, creating an umbrella above Chopper Base and the remaining rebel ships. Despite the shield generator taking heavy damage, Rex and Zeb were pleased when the shields appeared to hold up. After Thrawn deployed ground forces, Dodonna theorized that Thrawn would send his forces through the narrow canyon leading to Chopper Base. Rex proposed guarding the passes, which Hera approved. Rex destroyed several of Thrawn's AT-DP walkers with detonators while Zeb destroyed the last one with a rocket launcher. However, the two rebels were forced to retreat when Thrawn deployed several AT-AT walkers, which were protected by shield generators. After reuniting with Kanan, the three rebels fled into the caves under the [[Atollon Coral Mesa]] and fought Thrawn's [[death trooper]]s and [[stormtrooper]]s. After reuniting with Hera, General Dodonna, and AP-5, they tried to flee to the ''Ghost'' but were surrounded by Thrawn and his death troopers. Before Thrawn could take them prisoner, Kanan's mysterious friend [[Bendu]], the enigmatic Force-wielder, unleashed a thunderstorm which devastated the base. Rex and his rebel comrades fled aboard the ''Ghost'' and joined the rebel fleet in space. By that stage, Ezra had returned with Mandalorian reinforcements led by Sabine and Fenn Rau. The Mandalorians destroyed Thrawn's second interdictor cruiser, allowing the rebel remnants to flee into hyperspace. Under the orders of Hera, the rebel convoy set a course for [[Yavin 4]]. When AP-5 proposed doing two jumps to cover their tracks, Rex recommended a third jump. =====The Massassi Group===== Following the Battle of Atollon, Rex and the other surviving members of Phoenix Squadron joined the Massassi Group, a Rebel Alliance unit based on the jungle moon Yavin 4. Rex, several Spectres, and rebel ground crew were present at the airfield outside the [[Great Temple]] when Hera's squadron of Y-wings landed. Since the fighters had sustained damaged, the Y-wings including Hera's starfighter had trouble landing. Rex remained on Yavin 4 while the Specters undertook a [[Mission to Jalindi|mission]] to destroy the [[Jalindi Station|Imperial relay]] on [[Jalindi]]. Later, Rex and the former Imperial Security Bureau Agent Alexsandr Kallus accompanied the Specters on an [[Theft of the TIE Defender Elite|undercover mission]] to the Imperial-occupied planet of Lothal. Hera placed Rex in charge of looking after the ''Ghost'' while the Spectres infiltrated Lothal aboard [[Cikatro Vizago]]'s freighter ''[[Broken Horn]]''.{{Rebels|The Occupation}} =====Mustering allies===== [[File:Hera_mustering_allies.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rex and Hera recruiting allies for their cause]] Following the Spectres' [[Mission to the Lothal Jedi Temple|mission]] to the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]], Rex accompanied Syndulla and Kallus on a trip to the planet Seelos to recruit several old friends of Ezra to assist in the [[liberation of Lothal]]. As the ''Ghost'' entered Seelos' atmosphere, Rex contacted his fellow Clone veterans Gregor and Wolffe; who had settled in a former AT-AT walker known as [[Joopa Base]] that was roaming G872.{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} At Joopa Base, Rex and his rebel comrades encountered Gregor, Wolffe, the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, his [[Ugnaught]] companion [[Melch]], and the Mandalorian bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo. Rex, Hera, and Kallus recruited the group to participate in the liberation of Lothal as a favor to Ezra. While traveling back to Lothal, the rebels waited in space at Hondo's suggestion to catch a ride on an Imperial [[Class four container transport]]. As they waited, Rex doubted that Ezra and the others could hold out against Governor Pryce's forces. Shortly, the container transport arrived, and the rebels latched the ''Ghost'' onto the ship. Upon arriving at the [[Lothal cliff dwelling]], Rex along with Gregor, Wolffe, and Kallus helped the other Spectres and Ryder's rebel forces defeat Pryce's remaining troops and capture the Imperial Governor. =====Liberating Lothal===== [[File:Lothal_rebels_and_Spectres_inside_the_Dome.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rex and the infiltration team securing the Dome]] Captain Rex participated in an operation to infiltrate the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|"Dome"]] alongside Wolffe, Gregor, and multiple other allies. The center of Imperial power on Lothal, the Dome was a mobile [[Imperial Planetary Occupation Facility]] that was equipped with thrusters. The rebels used two captured [[LAAT/le patrol gunship|patrol transports]] to fly to the Dome. For the operation, Rex disguised himself as a stormtrooper. During the flight, Rex reassured a skeptical Gregor that Ezra's plan would work because he was a [[Jedi]].{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}} With the help of an unwilling Governor Pryce, the rebels landed at the Dome's executive landing pad. Following a brief battle, the rebels captured the command center. With the help of [[Ryder Azadi]], the rebels issued a faux [[Protocol 13]] which caused the Imperial garrison on Lothal to evacuate aboard the Dome. Before the rebels could launch the mobile base, Grand Admiral Thrawn returned aboard the ''Chimaera'' and blocked their path. Since Thrawn's [[Noghri]] [[assassin]] [[Rukh]] and the Imperial forces had disabled the Dome's deflector shield generator, the ''Chimaera'' was able to bombard Capital City. Ezra stopped the bombardment by offering to surrender himself. When Zeb proposed using the Dome's cannons to blast the ''Chimaera'', Rex advised against it since their weaponry was no match for the Star Destroyer's firepower. Despite Rex and Hera's objections, Ezra escaped on a patrol transport and went up to face Thrawn aboard the ''Chimaera''. In Ezra's absence, the rebels endorsed Sabine's plan to recapture the north and south power terminals in order to restart the Dome's shield generators. Rex along with his fellow Team A members Hondo and Ketsu Onyo were assigned to the north power terminal. Despite fierce Imperial resistance, the rebels reached the north power terminal after Ketsu used a manual override to extend the bridges. Sabine also aided Rex's team by sealing a blast door so that they could proceed with their mission to reactive the power terminal. When Hondo's Ugnaught companion Melch arrived with a stormtrooper hot in pursuit, Rex shot the trooper. Rex was distraught when his Clone comrade Gregor was shot in the chest while taking part in the assault to secure the south tower. After restarting the north power terminal, Rex attended to his fallen comrade. Gregor told him it was a pleasure fighting alongside him for a greater cause before dying in his arms. After Ezra summoned a pod of purrgil to carry him, Thrawn, and the ''Chimaera'' into uncharted space, Rex and the other rebels watched in shock in the command center. The rebels then launched the Dome into Lothal's upper atmosphere. As stormtroopers tried to storm the command center, Rex and the other rebels evacuated aboard the ''Ghost'', which was being flown by Rex's fellow clone trooper Wolffe, Mart Mattin, and Cikatro Vizago. Once safely airborne, the rebels detonated the Dome, wiping out the Imperial garrison on Lothal and ending Imperial rule on the planet. General Syndulla told Rex to bring out every [[Star map|star chart]] along Ezra's last known trajectory. However, they received a pre-recorded message by Ezra telling him that he made a difficult decision and thanking the Spectres for being his family. Rex warned that the Empire would return to the planet, an assessment shared by Kallus who hoped that the Rebel Alliance would finally send support. He and his allies decided to help defend Lothal but in addition to that, he continued to work with the Rebel Alliance with General Syndulla. Despite Rex's fears, the Empire never returned to Lothal. ====Battle of Endor==== {{Quote|Hera fought in the battle of Endor, as did Commander Rex.|Sabine Wren reflecting on the fall of the Empire|}} [[File:Rex_Han_and_Leia.png|thumb|left|158x158px|Rex served on Endor during the war]] In the years following the Battle of Atollon, Rex continued to serve in the Rebellion and work alongside its leaders. Rex, who had since been promoted to the rank of commander, was selected by General [[Han Solo]] and [[Major]] [[Bren Derlin]] to be part of the [[Endor strike team|strike team]] to bring down the [[Death Star's shield generator]] on the moon of [[Endor]]. While on the moon, Rex encountered R2-D2, who was delighted to see his old comrade-in-arms as part of the team. Rex served in the [[Battle of Endor]], fighting to ensure Emperor Palpatine could never hurt his clone brothers, or anyone else, ever again.''[[Star Wars: I Am a Clone Trooper]]'' Indeed, the battle proved to be a major victory for the Rebel Alliance; in addition to the destruction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]], Palpatine was killed by none other than{{Film|VI}} Rex's former Jedi General, Anakin Skywalker, who redeemed himself back to the [[light side of the Force]] to save his son, [[Luke Skywalker]]. The man now formerly known as Darth Vader died shortly afterward, and Luke gave him a [[Funeral of Anakin Skywalker|funeral]] on Endor. Rex continued to fight against the Galactic Empire after the Battle of Endor. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Next you're going to tell me that you weren't planning to mention Captain Rex, Ahsoka, Ventress, Cad Bane, Savage Opress, Jar Jar, and the Mandalorians?''"
"''Well... I guess I could always go back and tell their stories later.''"
"''Out of order?|A Whill, to another|{{StoryCite|story=Whills (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}}} [[File:RexSiegeOfMandalore-Ahsoka.png|thumb|300px|Rex, as he appeared to Tano in her experience in the World Between Worlds]] During Ahsoka Tano's experience with the [[Force spirit]] of Anakin Skywalker in the [[World Between Worlds]], Rex appeared to her amongst [[Force vision|visions]] of her past on Ryloth and Mandalore during the Clone Wars.{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}} Rex was mentioned in a collection of hand-drawn maps with a focus on the Skywalker family and its exploits''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' done by the artist [[Gammit Chond]], whose work would later be published by the [[Graf Archive]] as the ''[[Galactic Atlas]]''.{{GermanFanCite|96|Database}} Rex was pictured in Chond's maps of Geonosis, Christophsis, which further described his actions in its battle, and Kamino, where he was referred to as an Advanced Recon Commando. The Graf Archive was unsure about the accuracy of all of Chond's writings; indeed, Rex had once remarked that he was not an ARC trooper but Fives was, yet Rex had also been given ARC training and affirmed in his text ''[[The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]'' he had received the honor of ARC status. Rex was remembered by a [[Unidentified second Whill|member]] of the [[Whills]], as someone to be remembered in [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]]. The Whill mentioned Rex and the others when they learned that the [[Unidentified Whill|Whill]] tasked with writing about galactic history in the [[Journal of the Whills]] intended to start with the Galactic Civil War. The writer clarified Rex and the others' stories would be told, but the other Whill protested that it was being done out of order. ==Personality and traits== ===Captain in the clone army=== {{Quote|Sir, if I may address your accusation, I followed your orders. Even in the face of a plan, that was, in my opinion, severely flawed. A plan that cost us men. Not clones! Men! As sure as it is my duty to remain loyal to your command, I also have another duty. To protect those men.|Rex, referring to his clone troopers as men, to General Krell on his role as captain|}} [[File:Rex_Clone_Captain_WotF.png|thumb|left|250px|Rex wearing his Phase II clone trooper armor during the Clone Wars]] A legend amongst his clone brothers, Rex was a dedicated veteran soldier{{Databank|clone-captain-rex|Clone Captain Rex|oldversion=20150619112421}} and brave Clone Captain, later a Clone Commander. Rex was produced from the template of the bounty hunter Jango Fett. Rex even had adapted Jango's blaster-spinning routine with his pistols. As with all of his fellow clone troopers, Rex lived to serve the Galactic Republic and to protect its citizens. While he was eager to follow orders, Rex adopted a less rigid approach as the Clone Wars wore on. Indeed, while he was someone with an absolute loyalty to the Republic and his Jedi leaders, even he would find himself plagued with doubt as the Clone War dragged on, taking more lives and ruining more planets. During the Clone Wars, Rex would work alongside the Clone Commander Cody, the Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, and the Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano. He was also loyal to his men, feeling that protecting them was one of his primary duties as a leader. He tried not to dwell on any of the deaths of his countless friends and brothers, but when he had reason to believe that his comrade Echo was alive, he clung on to this belief. During the Clone Wars, Rex's priorities were first and foremost to his clone brothers, whom he loved deeply. He was disgusted by Clone Sergeant Slick's betrayal of the Republic during the Battle of Christophsis, and was greatly anguished having to defend himself and shoot his own men during the execution of Order 66. Rex was particularly close to Commander Cody, as well as ARC troopers Fives and Echo. He greatly mourned the sacrifice of clone trooper Hevy; despite not having known the clone for very long, Hevy made a significant impression on the captain. Rex was also devastated by Fives's death and the apparent death of Echo, whom he was determined to rescue when it was discovered that he was alive. At some point, a photograph was taken of Cody, Fives, Echo, and Rex, which Rex treasured greatly. He was close with many other members of the 501st as well, including clone medic Kix, ARC trooper Jesse, and troopers Hardcase and Tup, among others. [[File:LawquaneDinner.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Lawquane family challenged Rex's understanding of what it meant to be a clone trooper.]] Rex allowed the clone deserter Cut Lawquane to continue living his life away from the war. Rex and Lawquane's wife, Suu, were also friends.{{InsiderCite|219|Day Wanna Wanga - The Tale of the Twi'leks}} He was also close with Commando Gregor—whom he considered an old friend—and Commander Wolffe, living with the two of them for many years following the Clone Wars. However, despite his love for his brothers, when they were controlled by their inhibitor chips during Order 66, Rex was willing to kill them if it meant saving Ahsoka's life. It was not a decision Rex made lightly, with the Clone Officer crying at the thought that his brothers had been brainwashed to lay down their lives to kill him and Tano. Although in the end Ahsoka told him not to kill them, the clones were killed in the crash of the ''Tribunal'', but Rex and Tano made sure to bury their bodies to honor their former friends. ===Friend to the Jedi=== {{Quote|Gives us clones all a mixed feeling about the war. Many people wish it never happened. But without it, we clones wouldn't exist.''"
"''Well, then perhaps some good has come from all of it. The Republic couldn't have asked for better soldiers, nor I a better friend.|Rex and Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:Shatterpoint-Rex.png|thumb|left|250px|Rex had great loyalty to the Republic and defended it by facing the Separatist Droid Army.]] Rex was very close with his Jedi General Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, harboring deep respect and friendship for the man. The two trusted each other with their lives on a near-constant basis, and Skywalker even trusted Rex to know about his secret marriage and to act as lookout whenever he wished to talk to her via hologram. The two were close enough that friendly teasing was commonplace in their conversations. Rex trusted Skywalker despite some of his risky plans, noting that Skywalker always led from the front and appreciating his commitment to his troops. Rex also developed a friendship and close bond with Skywalker's Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, even becoming a mentor to her by offering her advice and valuable leadership experience, teaching her that experience outranked everything. When Tano was framed for murder and treason, Rex doubted that she had committed the crimes, but followed the order to arrest her nonetheless. Despite this, the two would maintain a deep respect for each other after the Clone Wars. Rex and many of the other clones repainted their armor when Tano returned to their ranks shortly before the Siege of Mandalore. Although Tano told him that he did not have to refer to her as commander anymore since she had left the Jedi Order, Rex did so anyway. When Order 66 was issued, Rex managed to resist his programming long enough to warn Ahsoka, before succumbing to the order. Under the influence of order 66, Rex's goal was to kill Ahsoka. However, after Ahsoka had Rex's inhibitor chip removed, his loyalty to Ahsoka returned, and he was willing to kill own brothers to save her life. During the Imperial Era, Tano recalled her clone trooper friend when she saw the farmer [[Kaeden Larte]], whose skin she noted to be darker than Rex's, albeit lighter than Mace Windu's. Later, she refused to imagine two stormtroopers as sharing Rex's face. Later during the Age of the Empire, Rex reunited with Tano by joining the rebellion. His knowledge of former Republic military bases, combat skills, and military tactics would help the rebellion in its fight against the Galactic Empire. He was devastated when he learned about her presumed death on Malachor. ===Soldier without a Republic=== Surviving the execution of Order 66, one of Rex's first priorities was to warn Cut Lawquane about the control chips before he made it his mission to fight the Empire. Even though he knew the government he had once served was gone, Rex believed elements of the Republic, like his clone brothers, still survived, convincing the captain to continue his life's mission to defend it. Nevertheless, he admitted to Hunter that he was still trying to find his place in the galaxy. Echo believed Rex's resistance allowed clones like them to be soldiers without serving the Empire. Upon learning that the Bad Batch had not removed their inhibitor chips, a concerned Rex warned them about what the chips do to the clones. Although Hunter had promised his squad would help Rex whenever he needed it, Rex ensured he only contacted them in cases of extreme importance, such as the rescue of Gregor. Later in the Imperial Era, Rex was willing to stay out of affairs until he decided to join with the Rebellion. He recognized that the Rebels helped people in the galaxy, while he saw that the Empire brought pain to the lives of many.{{RebelsMagCite|18|Academy Cadets}} ===Relationship with his fellow veterans=== While Rex initially had a difficult relationship with the Jedi Purge survivor Kanan Jarrus and argued over strategies and Ezra Bridger's priorities, the two put aside their differences following a mission to rescue Ezra and Commander Jun Sato from an Imperial Interdictor. Rex was staunchly loyal to the Old Republic and refused to recognize the authority of the Galactic Empire after his inhibitor chip was removed by Tano. Rex's fortitude led him to resist torture at the hands of the Imperial officer Brom Titus. He also regarded Imperial stormtrooper armor as inferior to the clone trooper armor he wore during the Clone Wars, just as he viewed the stormtroopers themselves as inferior to clone troopers. Especially compared to the other rebels, Rex was much more disciplined and by-the-book due to his military background. [[File:RexSeason7-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|339x339px|Rex in action during the Clone Wars]] Due to his Clone Wars experiences, Rex harbored a significant antipathy for battle droids. However, he had a friendly relationship with Anakin Skywalker's astromech R2-D2 and a respectful relationship with the Lothal rebel cell's astromech droid Chopper. Additionally, he showed respect and even some compassion toward a turncoat B1 battle droid nicknamed Bats during the Clone Wars. His animus towards battle droids led him to reject Kalani's demand that Rex and his Jedi comrades Jarrus and Bridger take part in a reenactment of the Clone Wars. As a clone trooper, Rex was bred to fight and wanted to finish his mission to destroy his battle-droid opponents. However, Bridger convinced Rex and Kalani to put aside their past differences in order to fight the Empire. Rex harbored considerable respect and loyalty to his former Clone Wars comrade Saw Gerrera, whom he had first met during the Onderon campaign. While Rex was unwilling to abandon his former comrade, he still expressed discomfort with some of Gerrera's harsh methods including brutalizing the Geonosian captive Klik-Klak and threatening to destroy the last Geonosian queen egg. Still, Rex was empathetic to Gerrera's pain and realized that his comrade was still grieving the loss of his sister Steela. Rex's belief in the sanctity of life led him to fight with Saw when the latter threatened to destroy the last Geonosian queen egg. ===Member of the Rebellion=== {{Quote|Tell me, what's it like to be a ''traitor''?''"
"''I'm ''no traitor''. You want an answer, ask the Emperor about it.''"
"''Don't you feel ''guilty'' for ''turning'' your ''back'' on the ''Empire'' and ''joining'' these ''rebels''?''"
"''These "''rebels''" are ''saving people's lives'', which is more than the Empire's been doing across the galaxy.|Jeken and Rex|{{RebelsMagCite|18|Academy Cadets}}}} [[File:Captain_Rex_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|Rex wielding his signature DC-17 hand blasters]] Rex had a deep respect for Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi due to their shared experiences during the Clone Wars. However, despite wanting to believe Kenobi was alive, he believed Bail Organa's word that the Jedi Master had perished. Rex was proven wrong when Bridger encountered Kenobi during an errant mission to Tatooine. Rex and his friend Zeb also had a sense of humor, even during the rebellion's difficult times. During the Battle of Atollon, they traded jokes about joopa and quipped about Sabine's prototype shield generator. By the time that the Spectres returned to Lothal, Rex had become acquainted with his former Imperial foe Kallus. General Syndulla placed Rex in charge of looking after the ''Ghost'' in her absence. Rex used his knowledge of Gregor and Wolffe's whereabouts to help Ezra find them, Ketsu, Hondo, and Melch in order to recruit them for Ezra's mission to liberate Lothal. Rex later used his military experience and combat skills to help the rebels capture the Dome during the Liberation of Lothal. As a warrior, Rex believed that the rebels needed to be on guard should the Empire return to Lothal. ==Skills and abilities== [[File:Rex_DoR.png|thumb|right|220px|Rex favored his clone trooper gear.]] {{Quote|I know someone who might be able to help us. A great military commander with a vast knowledge of the Outer Rim. He could assist us in finding a base, and his experienced leadership would make him a powerful ally.|Ahsoka Tano describes some of Rex's skills|}} Rex was a skilled military commander and a respected leader who won the respect of his men and peers. Due to his combat experience with battle droids, Rex was familiar with robolobotomy. While he was trained to wield firearms, Rex was also proficient in unarmed combat. Besides fighting droids and Imperials, Rex also had some experience dealing with the spider-like krykna which lived near Chopper Base, the Phoenix rebel base on Atollon. Rex also knew how to handle machinery, fly a Y-wing starfighter with ease, and resist mind tricks. Rex put his combat and technical skills to good use when he escaped the ''Tribunal'' with Ahsoka Tano in a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber|Y-wing bomber]]. Avoiding mediocre Imperial security on Raada, Tano understood that, if Rex were in charge of the operation, the security would be more effective; the stormtroopers were solely focused on patrolling the construction workers, while she knew Rex would have had his troops patrol through the streets, even if it made building more difficult. Comparing the lackluster security measures to Rex's standards convinced her the officers in charge were young. Lending the leadership skills he had developed in the clone army to the Rebel Alliance, Rex became a successful rebel. He also demonstrated his skills in a successful rebel operation to infiltrate and launch the Dome during the Liberation of Lothal. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Generation one armor always holds up.|Rex, on his clone trooper armor|}} [[File:RexUnderFire-BS.png|thumb|left|240px|Rex preferred to wield his DC-17 pistols in combat.]] During the Clone Wars, Rex wore both [[Phase I clone trooper armor|Phase I]] and heavily customized [[Phase II clone trooper armor]]. In the days of Phase II, he wore a unique armor set composed of phase II with phase I elements welded on, including his phase I helmet visor. His armor was customized with a set of distinctive markings in blue,{{Databank|clone-captain-rex|Clone Captain Rex|oldversion=20140703051917}} the color used across the 501st for gear colorization. Rex also utilized a jetpack during various battles. [[File:RexHomeHero10312011.png|thumb|173x173px|Rex's jaig eyes]] During the Imperial Era, Rex also took to wearing a cloak over his armor, allowing him to hide his face. His helmets were known for sporting Jaig Eyes, a Mandalorian symbol of honor. Someone who enjoyed wielding two [[blaster pistol]]s at once, Rex used dual [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 blaster pistols]] in combat during the Clone Wars and continued to use them after the fall of the Republic. Rex also made use of a modified [[Rex's ARC-170|ARC-170 starfighter]] during the Clone Wars''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' and escaped Order 66 aboard a Y-wing bomber, which he went onto use during the Imperial Era. ==Behind the scenes== ===Depiction and development=== [[File:Rex-AhsokaCharacterPoster.png|thumb|left|250px|Rex's live-action appearance from ''Ahsoka'']] Rex was created for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]], which ran from [[2008]] to [[2013]] on [[Cartoon Network]], on Netflix in [[2014]], and on [[Disney+]] in [[2020]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who reprised his role in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second]], [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third]] and [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth seasons]] of the [[Disney XD]] television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. [[Temuera Morrison]] would later play Rex in "[[Part Five: Shadow Warrior]]," the fifth episode of ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''. [[Rex/Legends|He]] has also appeared in several [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] and non-[[canon]] media including the [[Dark Horse Comics]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|Slaves of the Republic]]'' story arc and ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. According to the ''The Clone Wars'' film DVD commentary, the series' creators originally intended to use the Legends clone trooper [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series as the series' prime clone character. However, ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] objected to Alpha's inclusion as it would have made too much alliteration (Anakin, Artoo, Ahsoka, and Alpha), leading to the conception of Rex. Later in the commentary, [[Dave Filoni]] stated Rex's use of twin blaster pistols was a direct reference to clone template Jango Fett. Filoni claimed Rex was more like Jango than some of his fellow troopers.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] DVD commentary Before the cancellation of ''The Clone Wars'' series, [[Brent Friedman]] wrote scripts for a four-episode arc starring Rex and R2-D2. A heated rivalry between the Clone Army's general ground forces and [[Clone trooper pilot|pilots]] and their droids would ultimately result in Rex flying a starfighter with R2 as his copilot. They would crash and be stranded together on one of the [[moon]]s of [[Ryloth]],{{SW|url=news/swca-the-untold-clone-wars-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: The Untold ''Clone Wars'' Panel Liveblog}} where most of the episodes would take place.{{Twitter|BFree63|status/588844674867068929|[[Brent Friedman]]|quote=@JacobRegan18 nope.
